jobs.title: Project Coordinator
jobs.description:
Sawhorse Productions is a Los Angeles based, Award winning full\-service creative studio turning ideas into unforgettable experiences through captivating branded content, viral social moments, and groundbreaking interactive experiences. We partner with industry\-leading brands, artists, and studios such as Walmart, Google, NBCUniversal, Fanatics, Toyota, Pepsi and Alo to deliver industry leading, innovative multi\-platform content. At Sawhorse, we believe in fostering a culture of collaboration, creativity, and relentless excellence while shaping the future of digital storytelling.


Our projects include:

* Branded content
* Social/Digital Content
* Broadcast commercials
* UGC Gaming platform experiences
* Interactive/Web3 activations (AR, VR, MR, AI)


We are seeking a highly organized, detail\-oriented Project Coordinator to provide administrative support to our Head of Production and Assistant Head of Production. This is a great opportunity for someone continuing to build experience in the film and production industry, and who thrives in a fast\-paced environment juggling multiple priorities under tight deadlines.

 **This role starts as a part\-time hourly position at 30 to 40 hours per week, with the potential to transition to a full\-time role based on fit and business need.**

**Our office is located in Studio City, Los Angeles. This is a primarily in\-office role, with occasional remote flexibility. General working hours are 9:30 AM to 6:00 PM PST with a 30\-minute break.**

 **Requirements**  

* Administrative Support: Manage day\-to\-day administrative duties for the Head of Production and Assistant Head of Production, including email management, call coordination, expense processing, travel planning, and general office management.
* Meeting Coordination: Schedule and coordinate conference calls, meetings, and events. Distribute meeting agendas and capture action items so nothing falls through the cracks.
* Calendar \& Deadline Tracking: Meticulously track and maintain project and production calendars to ensure deadlines and milestones are met across active productions.
* Deck \& Document Preparation: Tweak, proofread, and organize presentations, creative decks, and reports for both internal and client\-facing use.
* Staffing \& Bandwidth Tracking: Track staffing and department bandwidth to ensure sufficient personnel coverage across projects.
* Team Alignment: Show up engaged in high\-level department meetings and help keep the team aligned and in the loop on updates and project statuses.
* Office Operations: Support day\-to\-day office operations to keep the Studio City space running smoothly and the team focused on the work.


Qualifications* Experience: 1\+ year of professional experience working within a studio, network, agency, or production company in an administrative or equivalent capacity.
* Organization: Exceptional organizational skills and attention to detail.
* Communication: Strong written and verbal communication skills.
* Multi\-Priority Management: Ability to manage multiple priorities under tight deadlines and work well under pressure.
* Software Proficiency: Proficiency with office and communication software including Slack, Google Workspace, Zoom, Microsoft Office, Excel, and Keynote.
* Proactive Mindset: A proactive, no\-task\-too\-small mindset with strong problem\-solving instincts.
* Anticipation: Ability to anticipate needs and gaps in admin support before they are voiced.
* Adaptability: Strong problem\-solving skills and ability to adapt quickly to changing priorities.
* Collaboration: Collaborative, positive, and solutions\-oriented mindset.
* Flexible Availability: Comfortable working weekends or late nights when project timelines require it.

  

Nice To Have’s* Prior entertainment industry or on\-set experience
* Familiarity with production management tools such as Airtable, Notion, or StudioBinder
* Interest in growing into a producer or production management role over time
* Experience supporting senior executives or department heads

  

**Benefits** **$40\.00 per hour,** with overtime after 8 hours


EEO Statement


Sawhorse Productions is an equal employment opportunity employer. All employees and applicants are evaluated on the basis of their qualifications, consistent with applicable state and federal laws. In addition, Sawhorse Productions will provide reasonable accommodations for qualified individuals with disabilities. Sawhorse Productions will consider for employment qualified applicants with criminal histories in a manner consistent with the requirements of applicable state and federal law.

jobs.title: PROJECT COORDINATOR - (COMMERCIAL PAINTING) - WEST LA
jobs.description:
Spectra CSI \| Full\-time \| On\-site \| Los Angeles, CA 90034

Pay: $35\.00 – $40\.50 per hour \+ benefits

We are a commercial painting contractor looking for a true **office\-driven Project Coordinator** who can own multiple jobs from the office side while tightly coordinating with the field, clients, and GCs.

This is **not** a pure field superintendent role and **not** a pure admin/payment\-tracking role. Approximately 5–10% of the role involves field visits for inspections and quality control.

**What you will actually do**

* Own project documentation: RFIs, submittals, change orders, logs, and closeout packages
* Coordinate materials, schedules, and status across multiple concurrent jobs
* Serve as the main office point of contact for clients, GCs, and field crews
* Track budgets, schedules, and finishes progress with clear ownership
* Conduct occasional field inspections and quality control checks (roughly 5–10% of time) to support finishes and issue resolution
* Use Excel (beyond basic), Bluebeam, Procore (or similar), and other construction tools daily
* Keep jobs moving by solving documentation and coordination issues before they become field problems

**Requirements**

* 1–3\+ years of construction project coordination, project engineering, or document control experience (commercial preferred)
* Proven experience with RFIs, submittals, change orders, and multi\-project tracking
* Comfortable working both independently and with field teams
* Strong written and verbal communication (client/GC\-facing)
* Higher\-level Excel skills and experience with construction software (Bluebeam, Procore, Planswift, or equivalent strongly preferred)
* Willingness to perform limited field inspections as needed
* Must be able to commute daily to our West LA office (90034 area)

**Do not apply if**:

* Your experience is primarily field superintendent, foreman, or crew leadership with little office\-side documentation ownership
* You have only pure administrative or recruiting experience

**Apply with a resume that clearly shows office\-side construction coordination experience**

Job Type: Full\-time

Pay: $35\.00 \- $40\.50 per hour

Benefits:

* Health insurance
* Health savings account
* Paid time off

Experience:

* Construction management: 2 years (Required)
* Project management: 3 years (Required)

Ability to Commute:

* Los Angeles, CA 90034 (Required)

Work Location: In person

jobs.title: Hiring Now! Assistant Project Coordinator
jobs.description:
### **Description**

  

Arellano Associates (AA) is a professional community outreach firm specializing in the transportation, clean energy, and water sectors. We bridge the gap between government agencies and the public by combining meaningful, digital and in\-person engagement with innovative technology to deliver a transparent and accessible communication process for our client's projects.  

  

By creating engagement opportunities for stakeholders to have a genuine voice in the planning and decision\-making process, we build trust, encourage collaboration, and help reduce disparities; working together toward a more connected, sustainable, and equitable California.  

  

The Assistant Project Coordinator (APC) is a full\-time, entry\-level role on the front lines of that work, supporting public outreach and stakeholder engagement for a project team under the guidance of a Project Manager. The position calls for learning agility, the ability to pick up new tools, including AI, quickly and apply them well. It also calls for ownership and follow\-through, the discipline to get the details right on a public meeting, a mailer, or a project update, since those are the details that ultimately make an impact on the communities we serve. This position is also a launchpad into a career in public outreach and project delivery, with plenty of room to grow within the company.  

  

Check out some of the Projects we are working on and how we are making an impact to communities all throughout Southern California!: https://www.arellanoassociates.com/projects  

### **Key Responsibilities**

  

* **Content Creation:** Draft written text for collateral materials including fact sheets, brochures, newsletters, posters, e\-communications, and social media content.
* **Messaging Support:** Help tailor draft content to project goals and different audiences, building an understanding of how messaging shifts depending on the community and client you're working with.
* **Event Coordination:** Support in\-person public engagement events such as public meetings, pop\-ups, and special events, including logistics, supplies, and staffing.
* **Public Interaction:** Engage directly with community members at outreach events, facilitate participation, and help gather public feedback that shapes project strategy.
* **Tech Tools \& AI:** Apply the latest tech tools, including AI tools such as ChatGPT, Copilot, and Claude, to communicate project information and gather public input, using platforms like ArcGIS, SurveyMonkey, MetroQuest, Poll Everywhere, Typeform, Google Forms, Constant Contact, Salesforce, SharePoint, and WordPress.
* **Creative Production:** Use Adobe Creative Suite programs, including InDesign, Illustrator, Photoshop, and Premiere Pro, for basic file creation and editing.
* **Vendor Coordination:** Coordinate vendor services including printing, catering, translation and interpretation, and toll\-free phone lines.
* **Database \& Website Management:** Keep stakeholder databases, project websites, and social media content current and accurate.
* **Digital Engagement:** Monitor public input coming through email, project websites, helplines, and online engagement tools, and flag issues or notable responses to your project manager promptly.
* **Task Tracking:** Organize and maintain project documentation, support scheduling, and help the team track progress and coordinate resources.
* **Project Support:** Complete tasks within timeframes and budget parameters, helping ensure timely and cost\-effective delivery.
* **Issue Communication:** Communicate issues and challenges to your project manager promptly.

  

### **What We Look For:**

 **In Every Team Member*** **Learning Agility:** You take feedback well and treat the unfamiliar as something to figure out rather than avoid. This industry and role will be new to most people who take it on, so you're the kind of person who asks a clarifying question instead of guessing. You are comfortable asking questions, jumping into something new, and curious about new technologies.
* **Ownership and Follow\-Through:** You follow through on what you say you will do, whether that's a deadline on a fact sheet or a task from a morning check\-in. When something's off, whether it's a typo you caught or a vendor that fell through, you speak up early instead of hoping it resolves itself, and you take pride in getting the details right.
* **Collaboration and Mentoring:** You work well with others and know a project runs better when everyone's pulling in the same direction. You help teammates succeed, whether that's covering an event when someone's out or walking a newer team member through a process you've already learned. Ultimately, you make the people around you better at their jobs.
* **Curiosity with Technology and AI:** You're comfortable picking up new software and tools, including AI tools like ChatGPT, Copilot, or Claude, and applying them to real tasks. Whether that's drafting a first pass at a newsletter or researching a project topic, you know good AI use means checking the work, not just accepting it.
* **Professionalism:** You represent yourself, AA, and our clients well in every interaction. From a public meeting to an internal email. You ask questions rather than guess, show up on time and prepared, and handle mistakes with maturity.

**For This Role*** **Public Interaction:** You're comfortable talking with members of the public, whether that's staffing a table at a community event, answering questions at a public meeting, or fielding a call from a concerned resident. You can translate technical project details into plain language, and you stay professional even when someone's frustrated. No professional outreach experience required, we'll help you build it.
* **Writing and Content:** You can put together a clear, accurate first draft, whether it's a fact sheet, a newsletter article, a social media post, or a project update. You take direction well on tone,

jobs.title: Digital Equity Program Coordinator
jobs.description:
**Advance Digital Equity Across LA’s BEST Communities \- Join Us As A Digital Equity Program Coordinator Today!**

 **About LA’s BEST**



LA’s BEST is a public/private partnership between the City of Los Angeles, the Los Angeles Unified School District (LAUSD), and the private sector, working together to provide safe, engaging, and enriching afterschool programming for elementary school students. Established 38 years ago, LA’s BEST serves children in neighborhoods with the greatest needs but the fewest resources, ensuring access to meaningful learning experiences beyond the school day.

  

Through this public\-private partnership, LAUSD operates the program, the City of Los Angeles provides crucial public support, and the nonprofit entity advocates for funding and resources. This shared commitment allows LA’s BEST to provide high\-quality enrichment activities that nurture academic growth, social\-emotional well\-being for students while also supporting working families across Los Angeles.

  

At LA’s BEST, we believe that diversity fuels innovation, creativity, and success. We are committed to fostering an inclusive workplace where every individual's unique perspectives, backgrounds, and experiences are valued and celebrated. As we continue to grow and evolve, we are dedicated to building a team that reflects the diversity of the communities we serve. We encourage applications from individuals of all races, ethnicities, genders, sexual orientations, abilities, ages, religions, and socioeconomic backgrounds. Join us in our mission to create an environment where everyone feels empowered to thrive and contribute their best work. Your voice matters, and we invite you to bring your authentic self to our team.

 **J****ob Overview \& Responsibilities**



Reporting to the Director of Evaluation, the **Digital Equity Program Coordinator** is responsible for coordinating and administering LA's BEST's Digital Equity initiative funded through the California Advanced Services Fund (CASF). The position serves as the primary operational lead for implementation of digital literacy programming serving both students and families across ten LA's BEST school sites.

  

Working closely with LAUSD, an external digital learning consultant/vendor, school principals, nonprofit staff, and grant stakeholders, the **Digital Equity Program Coordinator** oversees planning, scheduling, implementation, reporting, participant engagement, curriculum coordination, technology deployment, and program evaluation.

  

The **Digital Equity Program Coordinator** ensures that all grant deliverables, implementation milestones, and reporting requirements are completed on time while maintaining compliance with grant expectations, district requirements, and organizational standards. Programming includes both student\-focused digital literacy instruction (Digi Scholars) and parent/caregiver digital literacy programming (Parent Digital Connections). Core responsibilities may include but are not limited to:

  

Program Coordination \& Grant Administration (approximately 35%):


* Coordinate implementation of Digital Equity programming across all participating LA's BEST school sites.
* Manage overall project timeline and ensure all grant milestones are achieved.
* Serve as the primary liaison between LA's BEST, LAUSD, external consulting partners, and school site leadership.
* Monitor grant requirements, implementation benchmarks, and compliance documentation.
* Coordinate regular implementation meetings with internal staff and consulting partners.
* Track grant expenditures and coordinate purchasing requests with the Finance department.
* Prepare reports for organizational leadership and grant funders.

  



Program Operations \& Vendor Coordination (approximately 25%):


* Coordinate the work of the external curriculum and instructional consulting partner.
* Assist with scheduling instructors, consultants, and school site programming.
* Ensure instructional programming aligns with grant objectives and approved curriculum.
* Coordinate instructor training and onboarding.
* Monitor implementation quality across all school sites.
* Resolve operational issues affecting program delivery.

  



Family Engagement \& Community Outreach (approximately 20%):


* Coordinate outreach efforts supporting enrollment of students and families.
* Partner with school sites to recruit participants for student and parent programming.
* Coordinate multilingual outreach efforts and communication materials.
* Support community information sessions and family engagement events.
* Coordinate distribution of take\-home devices for eligible families.
* Maintain participant enrollment records and attendance documentation.

  



Technology, Data \& Evaluation (approximately 20%):


* Coordinate procurement, inventory, tagging, and deployment of digital devices.
* Maintain inventory records for grant\-funded technology.
* Collect participation, attendance, and outcome data.
* Monitor program fidelity and implementation consistency.
* Assist with grant reporting and evaluation activities.
* Develop dashboards and summaries demonstrating program impact.

* Ability to maintain regular and consistent attendance.
* Strong project management and organizational skills.
* Ability to coordinate multiple workstreams simultaneously.
* Strong relationship management with internal and external stakeholders.
* Ability to work collaboratively across nonprofit and public\-sector environments.

* Ability to manage grant\-funded initiatives with attention to compliance requirements.
* Strong analytical and problem\-solving abilities.
* Experience coordinating vendors and consultants.
* Ability to collect, interpret, and report program data.

jobs.title: Community Program Coordinator (Vintage Crossings)
jobs.description:
Project Access provides programs and services to over 27,000 children, families, and seniors living in affordable housing communities across the country. We strive to empower residents of affordable housing communities through our onsite services, aiming to create pathways for self\-reliance and personal growth.
  
  

Join the Project Access team and create impact in the lives of our residents. Hear from them and how their lives have changed: www.project\-access.org/success\-stories/
  
  

The opportunity
  
  

The Resident Services Coordinator designs and implements programs that enhance community life for residents of all ages. They serve as a vital link between residents and services, creating value through targeted initiatives that address community needs. This role requires an innovative, proactive individual who excels in an autonomous environment, driving positive long\-term outcomes through an understanding of the communities in which they serve.
  
  

What you'll do
  
  

Implement core programs and services, which include connecting, engaging, and empowering residents across four initiatives: Economic Stability, Education for Youth \& Families, Health \& Wellness, and Community Building.
  
Conduct outreach and survey resident needs through community engagement aligned with our four pillars.
  
Coordinate and oversee an after\-school program and teen program encompassing homework assistance and educational enrichment activities.
  
Independently plan, prepare, and facilitate resident\-facing workshops and group sessions. When external partners are unavailable, deliver core topics directly to maintain consistency and resident engagement.
  
Develop \& maintain partnerships with local providers to deliver services and workshops.
  
Plan \& facilitate community\-building events that foster safe and meaningful relationships between community members.
  
Provide residents with information \& referrals to access community resources and services, specifically connecting residents with nonprofit partners who deliver services within our four pillars framework.
  
Support food distribution needs in the community, including maintaining food bank partnerships and distribution management.
  
Develop and maintain strong relationships with the property management team, scheduling regular communication sessions.
  
Organize and conduct monthly outreach requirements including door\-to\-door outreach, digital/virtual outreach, and physical presence in high\-traffic locations.
  
Recruit, select, train, and oversee volunteers and interns who support programming at the Resource Center.
  
Use personal automobile to acquire program supplies and donations and attend offsite meetings (mileage reimbursed at IRS rate).
  
Publish monthly newsletters and calendar of events.
  
Collect \& submit program outcomes data with emphasis on social impact data collection to measure outcomes within our four pillars.
  
Provide input and adhere to budgets for resident service programs, including authority to utilize funds for contractors when needed.
  
  

What you'll bring
  
  

Bilingual English/Spanish or English/Farsi preferred
  
Two years of experience in multi\-family housing or related fields such as social services or community outreach; or a Bachelor's Degree in Social Work, Human Services, or related field.
  
  

**Experience in both:**  

after\-school programs or educational settings for youth
  
serving diverse populations, demonstrating cultural competency and community awareness.
  
Proficient with MS Office (Excel, Word, Publisher, Outlook). Basic with Adobe Acrobat, Canva, Salesforce, Concur.
  
Strong time management, administrative, and organizational skills.
  
Self\-starter, multi\-tasker, and strong communicator
  
The physical activity of this position includes minimal bending, walking, kneeling, reaching, and step climbing. Able to lift up to 30 pounds, which includes large boxes of food for a supplemental food distribution program.
  
Credentials/Certifications
  
Valid Driver’s License, clean driving record, and current automobile insurance
  
CPR \& First Aid certified (or obtained within 90 days of hire)
  
Successful completion of background check and LiveScan
  
  

**The details:**  

This is a part\-time (29 hrs/wk), non\-exempt position
  
**Schedule:** Mon/Weds/Fri 12:30pm\-5:30pm, Tues/Thurs 10am\-5:30pm; Ability to work an occasional Saturday for an event. Schedule is subject to change.
  
**Location:** Vintage Crossings Apartments, 700 East South St, Unit 100, Anaheim, CA 92805
  
**Wage:** $25hr
  
  

**Benefits offered:**  

Term life insurance and an Employee Assistance Program
  
Safe Harbor 401(k) with 4% company match
  
Pro\-rated paid time off \+ 14 paid holidays
  
  

Project Access, Inc. is an at\-will and equal opportunity employer, committed to creating an equitable and inclusive workplace. We value diversity in all its forms and actively seek to build a team that reflects the richness of our community. Our hiring practices are designed to identify and welcome talented individuals regardless of their race, ethnicity, cultural background, religious beliefs or practices, gender identity or expression, relationship status, age, neurotype, physical or sensory abilities, sexual orientation, military service history, or any other aspect of their identity protected by law. We believe that a diverse team leads to better ideas, more innovative solutions, and a stronger community impact. Our goal is to foster an environment where everyone can thrive and contribute their unique perspectives and skills.
  
  

Project Access participates in E\-Verify

Hyperkin is a gaming hardware and accessories company specializing in retro and modern gaming products. We are known for products such as the RetroN series and officially licensed gaming controllers, while continuing to develop new and innovative products for today's gaming market.

We are looking for a **Junior Marketing Coordinator** who is creative, organized, interested in gaming, and ready to learn. This is a hands\-on position where you will work directly with our marketing, design, sales, and product teams to help bring new products to market.

Responsibilities

* Assist with day\-to\-day marketing activities and product launches

* Write basic social media captions, product descriptions, and promotional copy
* Coordinate product photos, videos, samples, and marketing assets
* Assist with influencer and content creator outreach
* Research gaming trends, competitors, and new marketing opportunities
* Help monitor social media performance and prepare simple reports
* Assist with email marketing and website promotions
* Support trade shows, gaming events, product launches, and promotional campaigns
* Work with the graphic design team to coordinate marketing materials

* Help maintain the marketing calendar and ensure projects stay on schedule

* Comfortable using Instagram, TikTok, YouTube, and other social platforms

* Organized and able to manage multiple projects
* Creative mindset with attention to detail
* Basic knowledge of Microsoft Office or Google Workspace

* Interest in **video games, gaming hardware, retro gaming, or consumer electronics is strongly preferred**

jobs.description:
Job Summary:


**WHO ARE YOU?**

Are you passionate about electronic dance music and live events? Do you thrive in a fast\-paced environment where creativity, collaboration, and strategic marketing come together? We're looking for a highly motivated, proactive marketer with a passion for music, culture, and creating impactful campaigns that connect fans with unforgettable experiences. Is this you? Read on…  



**WHO ARE WE?**

Insomniac produces some of the most innovative, immersive music festivals and events in the world. Enhanced by state\-of\-the\-art lighting, pyrotechnics and sound design, large\-scale art installations, theatrical performers and next generation special effects, our events captivate the senses and inspire a unique level of fan interaction. The quality of the Headliner experience is our top priority.  



Insomniac produces 10,000 concerts, club nights and festivals for seven million attendees annually across the globe. Since its inception, Insomniac's events have taken place in 13 countries across five continents. The company's premiere annual event, Electric Daisy Carnival Las Vegas, is the world’s largest dance music festival and attracts more than 525,000 fans over three days. The company was founded by Pasquale Rotella and has been based in Los Angeles since it was formed in 1993\.  



**THE ROLE**

Insomniac Events is seeking a Marketing Coordinator to join our Festival Marketing team. This role plays a key part in the planning, coordination, and execution of integrated marketing campaigns that support our portfolio of festivals and branded events. Working closely with cross\-functional teams, artists, and external partners, the Marketing Coordinator helps bring campaigns to life while ensuring projects remain organized, on schedule, and aligned with overall marketing objectives.


This position reports to the Director of Festivals and is based in our Calabasas, CA office, with regular travel to on\-site event locations as needed. This is not a remote position.


**RESPONSIBILITIES**

* Collaborate with the marketing team to develop and manage integrated marketing campaigns across assigned festivals and brands.
* Partner with the team to brainstorm content strategies and manage social media content calendars for assigned projects.
* Work closely with artist teams to coordinate and secure artist assets in support of marketing campaigns.
* Partner with Executive Producers, marketing leads, artists, managers, and internal stakeholders to align campaign strategies, communicate priorities, and ensure timely execution.
* Collaborate with in\-house Design and New Media (video and motion) teams to develop creative campaign assets by submitting thorough creative briefs, coordinating production timelines, and securing necessary approvals.
* Create and manage design and media requests, ensuring creative assets are delivered accurately, on schedule, and aligned with campaign objectives.
* Assist in the execution of third\-party marketing partnerships and promotional campaigns for assigned festivals and brands.
* Support the execution of on\-site marketing initiatives, including media, social, influencer, and street team activations for assigned events.
* Ensure clear, timely, and accurate communication across cross\-functional teams and external partners throughout the campaign lifecycle.
* Stay informed on emerging marketing trends, social platforms, and industry best practices, applying new ideas and sharing actionable insights to drive innovative, forward\-thinking campaigns.
* Use a personal vehicle to travel to business engagements as needed and travel out of town for business when required.
* Attend company events as required, including domestic and international travel for full\-time employees.
* Work evenings and weekends as needed to meet deadlines and perform effectively under tight timelines and high\-pressure environments.

**QUALIFICATIONS**

* Bachelor's degree in Marketing, Communications, Business, or a related field.
* 2\+ years of experience in marketing, music, entertainment, or a related industry.
* Deep knowledge of electronic dance music, artists, genres, culture, and the Insomniac brand portfolio.
* Experience developing branded marketing copy while maintaining a consistent voice and tone.
* Strong organizational and project management skills with exceptional attention to detail.
* Proven ability to manage multiple priorities simultaneously, adapt quickly to changing deadlines, and thrive in a fast\-paced environment.
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills with the ability to collaborate across multiple teams.
* Experience with marketing and project management tools such as Asana, Google Analytics, Adobe Photoshop, and basic HTML is preferred.
* Willingness to work evenings, weekends, or outside of regular business hours as needed to support live events and time\-sensitive marketing initiatives.

**WORK ENVIRONMENT**

* Must be able to tolerate loud noise levels \& busy environments
* May work in drastic temperature climates on site at our events
Must be willing to frequently work and travel to events during evening and weekend hours, as required, to meet deadlines and work events  
* 

Applicants for employment in the U.S. must possess work authorization, which does not require sponsorship by Insomniac for a visa.  



**EQUAL EMPLOYMENT OPPORTUNITY**

We aspire to build teams that reflect and support the fans and artists we serve. Every day we aim to promote environments where everyone can be themselves, contribute fully, and thrive within our company and at our events. As a growing business we will encourage you to develop your professional and personal aspirations, enjoy new experiences, and learn from the talented people you will be working with.  



  

Insomniac strongly supports equal employment opportunity for all applicants regardless of age (40 and over), ancestry, color, religious creed (including religious dress and groo

**Dreaming big is in our DNA. It’s who we are as a company. It’s our culture. It’s our heritage. And more than ever, it’s our future. A future where we’re always looking forward. Always serving up new ways to meet life’s moments. A future where we keep dreaming bigger. We look for people with passion, talent, and curiosity, and provide them with the teammates, resources and opportunities to unleash their full potential. The power we create together – when we combine your strengths with ours – is unstoppable. Are you ready to join a team that dreams as big as you do?**

**SALARY:** $67,200 \- $79,800 , bonus eligible


**TERRITORY:** Los Angels, CA


**COMPANY:**

We are home to the nation’s most iconic beer and beyond beer brands, including Michelob ULTRA – America’s \#1 top\-selling beer – as well as Busch Light, Budweiser, Bud Light, Stella Artois, Cutwater Spirits, and industry\-leading craft brands. From our longstanding efforts to support American farmers, military, veterans, and first responders, to emergency drinking water donations and responsible drinking programs, we are guided by our commitment to the communities we call home and the 65,000 hardworking Americans who bring our beer to life. We are powered by a team that shares our passion to create a future with more cheers. Are you ready to join a team that dreams as big as you do?  



**ROLE SUMMARY:**

The Field \& Events Marketing Specialist (FMS) builds the local face of BeatBox in their market in the most relevant way and follows the BeatBox national strategies and priorities. Reporting to the Director of Field Marketing, you will build local networks including opinion leaders and essential influencers both online (social media) and offline. You will create marketing programs in the areas of our business; On Premise, Off Premise, events, and New Business opportunities that impact the heart of local consumers, leading to the successful development of the brand.

* Win over the 21\+ consumers to bring BeatBox to life in your market!

* Ability to maintain storage facility, infrastructure, product inventory, swag, and any additional marketing materials assigned to your area
* Identify event opportunities in your area that require sampling activations
* Identify Beatbox influencers and partnership opportunities to support your local market
* Develop social media content that could be used in local area campaigns

**Events:**

* Maintain focus on the home market while additionally co\-managing events
* Develop Brand Engagement Activation Team in home markets \- demos/scheduling and store visits
* Manage national/regional festivals from beginning to end (collaborating with BeatBox Field Events Managers) utilizing a master festival checklist
* Setup weekly 15\-minute check\-ins with the internal team 8\-10 weeks out from the festival to ensure staying on track

jobs.title: Logistics Coordinator
jobs.description:
Under the general supervision of the Logistics Manager, the Logistics Coordinator will be responsible for providing high\-level clerical and administrative support to the Logistics Department. In addition, the Logistics Coordinator will manage relationships with local vendors and help with decision making that impacts the company's import and FOB shipments.  



  

  

**Requirements** **ESSENTIAL DUTIES \& RESPONSIBILITIES**

* Entering shipment/vessel related information into the system such as container numbers, invoice numbers, vessel arrival dates, etc.
* Processing and preparing invoice packets for our Accounting and Order Management departments
* Maintain vendor relationships with local freight forwarders, drayage companies, and factories overseas
* Follow up with vendors to ensure all import shipments are booked and shipped on time
* Follow up with vendors to ensure that all shipping documents are received and processed in a timely manner
* Review and approve shipment bookings with freight forwarders
* Review and audit invoices that are received from our drayage and forwarding partners
* Monitor the inbound container process and coordinate with our drayage partners and warehouse teams to ensure containers are picked up from the local ports and returned on time
* Coordinate FOB direct shipments with overseas factories and vendors, including confirming cargo readiness, booking ocean/air freight, and tracking shipments from origin through delivery to ensure timely arrival
* Other tasks as needed or assigned

**QUALIFICATION REQUIREMENTS**


To perform this job successfully, an individual must be able to perform each essential duty satisfactorily. The requirements listed below are representative of the knowledge, skill, and/or ability required. Reasonable accommodation will be provided to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions.

**EDUCATION AND WORK EXPERIENCE:**

* High School Diploma Required
* 1\-2 years of experience in logistics, transportation, supply chain, or a related operational environment.
* Proficiency in Microsoft Office (Word, Excel, Outlook).

**KNOWLEDGE, SKILLS, AND ABILITIES:**

* Detail oriented
* Ability to work independently while maintaining accuracy
* Ability to read and understand purchase orders, sales orders, invoices, packing lists, and Bill of Ladings
* Experience with logistics systems, freight management, or transportation management tools preferred.
* Experience working with domestic and international import/export carriers preferred.
* Experience supporting customs clearance activities and transportation preferred.
* Interest and ability to learn new software and programs
* Ability to multi\-task and navigate through various systems and tools
* Excellent oral and written communication skills

**OTHER SKILLS AND ABILITIES:**

* Positive Attitude
* Team Player

**PHYSICAL DEMANDS:** The physical demands described here are representative of those that must be met by an employee to successfully perform the essential functions of this job. Reasonable accommodation may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions.


While performing the duties of this Job, the employee is regularly required to sit; use hands to handle or feel and talk or hear. The employee is frequently required to reach with hands and arms. The employee is occasionally required to stand; walk and stoop, kneel, crouch, or crawl. The employee must frequently lift and/or move up to 10 pounds and occasionally lift and/or move up to 25 pounds. Specific vision abilities required by this job include close vision, distance vision, color vision, peripheral vision, depth perception and ability to adjust focus.

jobs.description:

This role supports the day\-to\-day coordination and execution of creative projects by helping organize logistics, communication, timelines, assets, and production details from pre\-production through final delivery. The ideal candidate is detail\-oriented, responsive, eager to learn, and comfortable working in a fast\-paced creative environment where priorities and project needs may shift quickly.

The Assistant Content Coordinator will work closely with the marketing and creative teams and assist with communication and coordination between in\-house team members, freelancers, and external creative partners. **This is a full time, on site position based at our Los Angeles office.**

**Responsibilities**

* Coordinate content production projects across e\-commerce images, videos, paid ads, and social media assets from pre\-production through final delivery
* Support project planning by organizing timelines, shot lists, creative references, production notes, deliverables, and approval steps
* Communicate with freelancers, in\-house creatives, editors, photographers, videographers, designers, and marketing team members to keep projects moving smoothly
* Track project progress, follow up on pending tasks, and proactively flag potential delays, missing information, or unclear next steps
* Assist with shoot preparation, including content briefs, product needs, schedules, props, locations, talent details, and production logistics when needed
* Manage post\-production coordination, including asset handoff, feedback tracking, revision rounds, approval status, and final file delivery
* Keep creative assets, project documents, production notes, and final files organized and accessible for the team
* Help ensure all project information is accurate, up to date, and clearly shared with the right stakeholders
* Support urgent project needs and adapt quickly when timelines, priorities, creative direction, or production details change
* Assist the marketing team with day\-to\-day creative coordination and content operation needs

**Required Competencies**

* Strong organization and ability to manage multiple projects at the same time
* Clear communication and strong follow\-up skills
* Attention to detail and ownership over project information
* Proactive, solutions\-oriented mindset
* Ability to work well in a fast\-paced and changing creative environment
* Basic understanding of content production, photo/video shoots, editing rounds, approvals, and final asset delivery
* Comfortable coordinating with both internal team members and external freelancers

**Qualifications**

* 1 years of experience in a creative, marketing, production, e\-commerce, advertising, fashion, beauty, lifestyle, or social media environment preferred
* Previous experience as a marketing coordinator, production coordinator, creative coordinator, social media coordinator, project coordinator, or similar role is a plus
* Hands\-on experience supporting photo, video, digital content, paid ads, or social media production is preferred
* Familiarity with managing timelines, creative briefs, shot lists, revision notes, asset folders, and content deliverables

* Responsive and responsible with time\-sensitive communication, including **urgent messages or project updates outside standard work hours when needed**

**Preferred Qualifications**

**Job Title: Clinical Research Coordinator III\- Oncology**


**FSLA Classification:** Non\-Exempt


**Reports to:** CRC Manager

  


**Job Summary/ Objective:**



The Clinical Research Coordinator III is responsible for supporting the management and oversight of clinical trials. This role involves working closely with a team to ensure the smooth execution of research studies under the guidance of the Investigator and CRC Manager.

  


**Essential Functions:**


***Overseeing Clinical Trials:***


* Ensure smooth conduct of study visits and clinical trials.
* Monitor study participants’ health throughout the trial.
* Schedule study visits within protocol\-required timelines
* Coordinate lab work, imaging, and other required procedures
* Document all aspects of the study visit and subject status.


***Data Collection and Analysis:***


* Collect and enter data obtained from study visits into source documents, study logs, and EMR, as well as EDC where data management personnel are not assigned.
* Assist data management team with resolution of queries


***Participant Interaction:***


* Educate study participants about study objectives and visit procedures.
* Communicate with study participants regarding any adverse events or side effects and the management of them.
* Administer applicable questionnaires.
* Monitor participants' adherence to protocol guidelines.


***Collaboration and Compliance:***


* Liaise with laboratories
* Liaise with Imaging vendors
* Liaise with pharmacy staff and infusion nurses
* Liaise with regulatory and quality assurance departments on protocol adherence and documents.
* Monitor study compliance with protocols and ethical standards.
* Ensure adherence to regulatory requirements.


***Record Keeping:***


* Maintain research records, including source documents, study logs, case report forms, and EMR
* Direct specimen collection, labeling, packaging, transport, shipping, and storage.


***Logistics and Supplies:***


* Ensure all necessary equipment and supplies are in stock and functional.


**Education/Experience/Skills:**


***Education:*** Bachelor's degree preferred in a health\-related field


***Experience***: \+3 years of experience in Clinical Research


**Skills:**


***Regulatory***


* Filing and accessing documents, Study Submission Assistant, Conduct Close\-out Visits
* Report protocol deviations and SAEs to the IRB (where not performed by the Research Navigator)


***Finance***


* Stipend payments
* Manage site budgets
* Insurance Coordination


***Subject Interaction***


* Recruit, interview, screen, enroll, and randomize subjects
* Obtain Informed Consent
* Collect medical history
* Conduct study visits
* Triage patients' questions


***Administrative***


* Source documentation
* EDC completion
* Query resolution
* AE/SAE documentation and reporting
* Address protocol violations and deviations
* Order/ maintain supplies


***Clinical Skills***


* Phlebotomy preferred
* Vital Signs
* EKG
* Order and organize lab reports
* IP Administration
* Manage Medical Records


***Others***


* Support training and answer questions of other staff members
* Support monitoring visits
* Leads sponsor communication
* Manage subject visits during managers’ absence
* Liaise with Investigators in manager’s absence

Standard operating hours are Monday through Friday, 8:00 a.m. to 5:00 p.m. May be required to complete job\-related tasks outside of that time frame more than a standard 40\-hour work week. Requires prolonged walking, standing, bending, stooping, and stretching. jobs.title: Logistics Operations Coordinator
jobs.description:
**Job Description**

POVISON is seeking a detail\-oriented and proactive Logistics Operations Coordinator to support our U.S. logistics operations, with a primary focus on Direct\-to\-Consumer (DTC), final\-mile, and white\-glove delivery performance.

Fluency in Mandarin Chinese and English is **REQUIRED** for this position due to regular communication and coordination with POVISON's China\-based team.

This role is responsible for monitoring shipments from warehouse dispatch through final delivery, coordinating with warehouses and carriers, proactively identifying transportation risks, resolving delivery exceptions, and supporting successful delivery execution.

The Logistics Operations Coordinator will work closely with U.S. Operations, warehouses, carriers, finalmile delivery teams, internal support teams, and POVISON's China\-based team to ensure issues are identified early and driven through resolution.

**Key Responsibilities**

* Coordinate and monitor the end\-to\-end post\-shipment process for DTC orders, from warehouse dispatch through successful final delivery.
* Track shipment and delivery status throughout the transportation process and maintain visibility of open or at\-risk orders.
* Monitor warehouse and carrier exceptions in real time, including pickup delays, transit delays, prolonged tracking inactivity, damaged shipments, lost shipments, and delivery failures.
* Proactively identify orders at risk of becoming service exceptions based on shipment milestones, tracking activity, historical trends, and carrier performance.
* Take preventive action by communicating with warehouses, carriers, final\-mile providers, and internal teams before issues escalate.
* Coordinate POVISON's final\-mile and white\-glove home delivery operations, including delivery scheduling, access concerns, address issues, product questions, reschedules, returns, and delivery exceptions.
* Manage transportation and delivery exceptions including damaged or missing products, customer refusals, unable\-to\-fit situations, incomplete deliveries, unsuccessful delivery attempts, and assembly or installation concerns.
* Ensure appropriate photos, notes, tracking information, and supporting documentation are collected when necessary.
* Maintain ownership of open exceptions and drive issues toward resolution while providing timely updates to the appropriate teams.
* Respond to logistics\-related requests including address changes, expedited delivery requests, shipment intercepts, and other delivery needs.
* Communicate and coordinate regularly with POVISON's China\-based team in Mandarin and English regarding shipment status, inventory questions, product concerns, damages, delivery exceptions, and issue resolution.
* Utilize shipment tracking data and carrier performance information to identify trends, risks, and opportunities for operational improvement.
* Maintain accurate logistics records and provide Operations leadership with visibility into shipment performance, delivery issues, and unresolved exceptions.

**Required Qualifications**

* Fluent in Mandarin Chinese and English – REQUIRED
* Bachelor's degree or above.
* Strong verbal and written communication skills in both Mandarin and English.
* Strong Microsoft Excel skills, including Pivot Tables, VLOOKUP, and commonly used formulas/ functions.
* Ability to independently draft professional business communications regarding shipment exceptions, logistics inquiries, carrier issues, and delivery updates.
* Strong analytical, logical\-thinking, and problem\-solving skills.
* Strong attention to detail with the ability to identify potential risks from shipment tracking data and operational trends.
* Proactive approach to problem\-solving with a strong sense of urgency, ownership, and accountability.
* Ability to manage multiple shipments and exception cases simultaneously in a fast\-paced environment.
* Strong cross\-functional coordination skills with the ability to work effectively with warehouses, carriers, delivery teams, internal departments, and international teams.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Degree in Logistics Management, Supply Chain, Statistics, Accounting, E\-Commerce, Business, or a related field.
* Previous experience in logistics, transportation, supply chain, e\-commerce, or final\-mile delivery.
* Experience in cross\-border e\-commerce or Direct\-to\-Consumer (DTC) operations.
* Experience with furniture, home delivery, or white\-glove final\-mile delivery.
* Experience working directly with warehouses, carriers, and international teams.

jobs.title: Coordinator, Event Operations
jobs.description:
**OVERVIEW**



The Los Angeles Football Club (LAFC) is an MLS soccer club serving the greater Los Angeles area. LAFC is dedicated to building a world\-class soccer club that represents the diversity of Los Angeles and is committed to delivering an unrivaled experience for fans. LAFC's ownership group is comprised of local leaders and innovators of industry with intellectual capital, financial prowess, operations expertise, and success in the fields of entertainment, sports, technology, and media. LAFC is invested in the world's game and Los Angeles, constructing, and developing the 22,000 seat BMO Stadium and a top\-flight training center on the campus of Cal\-State Los Angeles.

**POSITION SUMMARY**



The Coordinator, Event Operations is responsible for assisting in general tasks required to run, maintain, and service the stadium and/or events. This position will also act as a liaison between the facility and clients, ensuring all clients' requirements are met, and facility rules, regulations, and policies are adhered to.



This role will be expected to work approximately 20% of the time overnight but may be subject to change depending on business needs.



This role reports to the Manager, Event Operations.


**ESSENTIAL FUNCTIONS**


* Coordinate and ensure completion of maintenance and repairs received from stadium Operations leadership.
* Contribute to training and coordinating part\-time operations crew in the completion of general tasks to service the stadium and/or events.
* Coordinate and facilitate operations related requirements and requests from various departments and contractors to ensure the facility is ready for each event.
* Support the installation and dismantle of various conversion equipment, including but not limited to, staging, temporary flooring, trussing, demountable seating, and chair set/strike.
* Regularly attend event planning meetings to ensure the Operations Department receives pertinent information to appropriate staff and prepare the facility for upcoming events.
* Partner with all applicable departments to provide clear, concise, and timely communications regarding event requirements and requests.
* Assist the department in tracking and accounting for inventory and all stadium equipment on a regular basis.
* Conduct periodic facility walk throughs to identify maintenance issues and provide solutions.
* Assist with the development and implementation of preventative maintenance schedules, departmental standard operating procedures, emergency procedures, and risk/safety policies are being adhered to and compliant with all governmental regulations including but not limited to Cal/OSHA.
* Other duties as assigned by Supervisor/Management.


**QUALIFICATIONS**


* Bachelor's degree in Business, Facilities Management, or related field from an accredited College or University preferred, or an equivalent combination of 3 – 5 years of training, experience, and education.
* Minimum of 1\-2 years' experience in arena or stadium operations required, preferably at a high\-volume location.
* Working knowledge of practices and procedures related to events, facility conversion, and maintenance of equipment.
* Ability to understand and work from general instructions, specifications, blueprints, sketches, event documents, and preventative maintenance schedules.
* Ability to build and maintain working relationships with peers, clients, exhibitors, patrons, and others encountered throughout the course of employment.
* Detail oriented with an ability to multi\-task and meet strict deadlines.
* Strong communication skills – both written and verbal.
* Working knowledge of Google Workplace and Microsoft Office Suite programs.
* Must be able to work flexible hours including nights, overnights, weekends, and holidays as needed.
* Must be able to lift up to 50lbs without assistance and stand/walk for long period of time.
* Must possess a current and valid California Driver's License.
* Current forklift and/or scissor lift certification is preferred.
* Bilingual in Spanish is a plus.


**SALARY RANGE**



At LAFC, we carefully consider a wide range of factors to determine a fair and equitable compensation package. The final offer amount will consider a wide range of factors that are considered in making compensation decisions including, but not limited to skill sets; relevant experience and training. jobs.title: Operations and Client Experience Coordinator
jobs.description:
**Overview:**

Join Ashley Ravid Group (ARG), a growing educational therapy practice where relationships matter just as much as results. We support students of all ages with learning differences, helping them close learning gaps, build confidence, and reach their full potential. We see the whole child and believe meaningful progress happens when students feel supported socially, emotionally, and academically.

Our team is made up of dedicated professionals with specialized training in evidence\-based programs and approaches designed to help students become confident, successful learners. We are passionate about what we do—and equally passionate about creating a warm, supportive experience for the families we serve.

As a Client Experience Specialist, you’ll help create an exceptional experience for our families while supporting the day\-to\-day operations of our practice. You’ll be part of a warm, collaborative team that values genuine connection, ownership, and making families feel supported and cared for.

*If you notice the little things, take initiative, bring ideas to the table, and genuinely care about making people’s lives easier, you’ll fit right in.*

**Key Responsibilities:**

**Client Engagement**

* Serve as the primary point of contact for prospective and current families via phone, email, website inquiries, and voicemail.
* Guide new families through the onboarding process by sending intake paperwork and ensuring all required forms are completed.
* Follow up with prospective families who have not responded within three business days.
* Check in with new families after their first week to ensure a positive experience and answer any questions.
* Provide warm, responsive, and professional customer service.

**Talent Acquisition**

* Review applicants through referral platforms (Indeed, LinkedIn), screen resumes, and identify qualified candidates for the CEO to interview.
* Help expand talent acquisition by identifying alternative platforms to recruit A\-players for the practice.

**Administrative Support**

Provide general administrative support to help ensure the practice operates efficiently and effectively, including:

* Responding to emails and phone calls
* Organizing paperwork and maintaining client files
* Updating records, databases, and practice management systems
* Assisting with billing, invoicing, superbills, and payment\-related tasks
* Providing administrative support to providers
* Assisting with general office organization, coordination, and follow\-up

**Systematizing ExperienceClient Intake \& Referrals**

* Track referrals and conversion rates.
* Oversee the client onboarding process from inquiry through enrollment.

**Operations \& Systems**

* Develop, document, and continuously improve internal workflows and systems to promote efficiency, consistency, and accountability.
* Maintain accurate and up\-to\-date client records and ensure all required documentation is complete and properly organized.
* Monitor associate and student anniversaries and coordinate reminders for appropriate rate reviews, increases, and celebrations.
* Assist with creating and updating SOPs for associates and operators

**Billing \& Financial Operations**

* Oversee client invoicing and notify CEO of amount for associate payment processing.
* Monitor outstanding balances and support collections.
* Collect unpaid invoices and reactivate previous clients.
* Identify areas where the company is leaking money.
* Help create a budget for each department (social media, community outreach, materials, PD).

**Performance \& Business Analytics**

* Track and report key performance indicators (KPIs), including:
* Referral\-to\-enrollment conversion rate
* Client retention rate
* Provider\-student match success rate
* Gross margin
* Close rate
* Revenue, profitability, and return on investment (ROI)
* Collect and analyze business data to identify trends and opportunities for growth.

**Administrative Oversight**

* Ensure operational processes run smoothly across all departments.
* Monitor client anniversaries and coordinate periodic account reviews with the CEO.
* Recommend improvements that enhance efficiency, client satisfaction, and profitability.

**Company Expansion**

* Assist with programming for summer sessions focusing on reading skills levels, executive functioning, and project expansions.

**Qualifications:**

* Proven experience in client relations, operations management, or a similar role.
* Strong organizational and multitasking skills.
* Excellent communication and interpersonal skills.
* Ability to analyze data and generate actionable insights.
* Experience with budget management and financial operations.

**How to Apply**

Think you’d thrive on a collaborative, engaging, and growing team? We’re looking for someone who brings warmth, initiative, creativity, and a genuine desire to make a difference. At ARG, there’s plenty of room to grow, take ownership, bring new ideas to the table, and be part of something with unlimited potential.

Send us your resume and a cover letter telling us a little about your experience and why ARG feels like the right fit for you.

jobs.title: Community Coordinator and PR
jobs.description:
**Overview**

We are seeking an energetic and passionate Community Coordinator and Public Relations (PR) professional to lead our community engagement initiatives and strengthen our relationships with local audiences. This paid position offers an exciting opportunity to craft impactful outreach strategies, manage community relationships, and elevate our organization’s presence through strategic communication and media relations. The ideal candidate will thrive in a dynamic environment, demonstrating exceptional communication skills, creativity, and a proactive approach to community involvement. Join us to make a meaningful difference while developing your skills in community management, marketing, and public relations.

**Responsibilities**

* Develop and implement comprehensive community outreach plans to foster strong relationships with local organizations, stakeholders, and residents.
* Manage social media platforms by creating engaging content, monitoring interactions, and executing targeted social media marketing campaigns.
* Coordinate public presentations and community events that promote organizational initiatives and encourage active participation.
* Cultivate media relations by building relationships with journalists, preparing press releases, and coordinating media coverage for community programs.
* Oversee volunteer management efforts, including recruitment, training, scheduling, and recognition initiatives.
* Handle client communication with professionalism, ensuring clear messaging and positive engagement across all channels.
* Collaborate with internal teams on strategic planning and project management to align outreach activities with organizational goals while managing budgets effectively.

**Experience**

* Proven experience in community engagement or outreach roles, demonstrating success in building community relationships.
* Strong public speaking skills with experience delivering presentations to diverse audiences.
* Proficiency in Microsoft Office Suite (Word, Excel, PowerPoint) for reporting and planning purposes.
* Demonstrated ability in social media management and social media marketing strategies.
* Excellent written communication skills for creating compelling content such as press releases, newsletters, and social media posts.
* Experience in public relations or media relations to effectively manage press inquiries and develop media partnerships.
* Bilingual abilities are highly desirable to reach broader audiences; additional skills in project management, budgeting, and business development are a plus.

Join us as a vital part of our team where your enthusiasm for community engagement will help shape meaningful connections! This role offers the chance to develop your strategic planning capabilities while making a tangible impact on the communities we serve. We value proactive individuals who excel at relationship management, possess strong organizational skills, and are eager to grow professionally within a vibrant organization committed to positive change.

Pay: $19\.00 \- $20\.00 per hour

jobs.description:
**About ISC**


Established in 1971, ISC began building custom power cables \& assemblies for Gateway, Kingston, and Xerox. With over 50 years of manufacturing experience, ISC is capable of meeting tight deadlines and changing forecasts while maintaining quality. Our products are in use worldwide in commercial and military aircraft, lifesaving medical devices, weapon systems, inflight entertainment, power systems, and countless commercial, industrial \& computer applications. Our facility is environmentally controlled, engineered for manufacturing flexibility, includes dedicated assembly labs for isolated program management, and a cleanroom facility. With dedicated professionals and assemblers regularly operating two full shifts, ISC operates with the most current high\-speed tooling, material handling, and test equipment.

 **Job Overview**


The **Account Manager (AM)** owns execution of customer programs across the full quote\-to\-cash lifecycle for assigned accounts. This role serves as the primary point of contact and customer advocate while driving internal coordination to ensure on\-time delivery, margin performance, and overall program success.


This is a hands\-on, operations\-focused role within a fast\-paced contract manufacturing environment. The Account Manager operates with a high level of ownership and accountability, partnering closely with Sales, Operations, Engineering, Sourcing, Accounting, and Customer Experience to successfully execute both new and existing programs. Success in this role requires direct involvement in customer communication, production coordination, scheduling, and order execution

 **What You'll Do:**

**Customer Ownership**

* Serve as the primary point of contact and advocate for assigned customer accounts
* Build and maintain strong, long\-term customer relationships
* Lead customer communications including meetings, calls, and periodic site visits
### **Program \& Order Execution**

* Own execution of customer accounts through the full quote\-to\-cash lifecycle, from initial quotation through shipment and cash collection
* Support onboarding of new customers and new programs, ensuring successful launch and internal alignment
* Provide proactive order status updates, delivery schedules, and open order reporting to customers
* Drive on\-time delivery performance across assigned accounts
### **Cross\-Functional Coordination**

* Collaborate with Sales, Operations, Engineering, Manufacturing, Purchasing, Accounting, and Customer Experience to meet customer requirements
* Coordinate manufacturability, feasibility, and delivery commitments with internal teams
* Drive accountability and clear communication across cross\-functional stakeholders
### **Commercial \& Pricing Management**

* Manage RFQs, re\-quotes, and ongoing pricing activities
* Coordinate material costs, labor inputs, and pricing updates with internal teams
* Support margin performance through effective pricing and cost awareness
### **Planning \& Forecasting**

* Manage customer forecasts, blanket orders, and Kanban programs
* Coordinate material pipelines and demand changes with Supply Chain and Production teams
* Support alignment between customer demand and internal production planning
### **Issue Resolution \& Continuous Improvement**

* Proactively identify and resolve delivery, quality, or supply chain issues impacting customer commitments
* Manage customer escalations and drive timely resolution
* Track quote outcomes, including closed\-lost business, and provide feedback to support continuous improvement
### **Systems \& Reporting**

* Utilize ERP/MRP systems to track orders, forecasts, and account performance
* Provide customer forecasts and sales\-related reporting to Sales Leadership
* Maintain accurate documentation of customer requirements and program details
### **Additional Responsibilities**

* Perform other duties as required to support business needs

 **Must\-Have Qualifications:**

* High school diploma or equivalent required
* 2\+ years of experience in account management, program management, or related roles within a manufacturing environment
* Experience managing customer orders, delivery schedules, forecasts, and open order reporting
* Experience coordinating cross\-functionally with production, planning, purchasing, engineering, or supply chain teams
* Ability to manage competing priorities in a fast\-paced manufacturing environment while maintaining strong attention to detail
* Experience handling delivery expedites, schedule changes, or supply chain\-related issues
* Exposure to quoting, RFQs, pricing coordination, or cost\-related discussions
* Working knowledge of ERP/MRP systems and manufacturing workflows
* Strong communication, organization, and problem\-solving skills
* Proficiency in Microsoft Excel, Outlook, Word, and PowerPoint

 **Bonus Points If You Have:**

* Experience in contract manufacturing, cable/harness assembly, electromechanical assembly, or molding environments
* Aerospace \& Defense industry experience
* Experience supporting high\-mix / low\-volume manufacturing environments
* Familiarity with Kanban programs, blanket orders, or customer forecasting processes

$70,000 \- $90,000/year \+ bonus

jobs.title: Key Account Manager
jobs.description:
**L.A. Hydro Jet \& Rooter Services** is seeking a **Key Account Manager** to join our team! The Key Account Manager (KAM) will be responsible for protecting, strengthening, and growing LA Hydro\-Jet's (LAH) most important customer relationships.

  

**What Sets L.A. Hydro\-Jet Apart:**


* **Competitive Pay:** **$80,000\-$100,000 \+****, plus incentive program**
* **Comprehensive Benefits:** Health, vision, dental, and life insurance
* **Retirement Plan:** 401K plan \+ match
* **Time Off:** Vacation and paid holidays

**Position Summary**

This person will serve as the primary relationship owner for an assigned portfolio of key accounts, developing strong connections with decision\-makers, understanding each customer's business and service needs, and proactively identifying opportunities to expand LAH's share of their business across multiple service lines. The KAM will accomplish this through regular customer contact, account planning, quarterly or semiannual business reviews, site visits, relationship\-building activities, and close coordination with LAH's operations, sales, estimating, and service teams to ensure the customer receives consistent value and strong support. Success will be measured primarily by year\-over\-year revenue growth within assigned accounts, customer retention, increased penetration of LAH services, and the strength of the overall customer relationship. The KAM will be expected to understand where each account stands financially, identify why an account is growing or declining, maintain a pipeline of expansion opportunities, and take action when business is at risk. Ultimately, the role is successful when key customers view LA Hydro\-Jet as a trusted partner and increasingly choose LAH as their primary—or preferred—service provider.

**WHAT L.A. HYDRO\-JET NEEDS FROM YOU:**
* 3\-5\+ years of B2B account management, strategic customer success, relationship management, or consultative sales experience.
* Demonstrated experience managing a book of business, large customer relationships, or multi\-location accounts.
* Track record of retaining and growing existing customer revenue.
* Strong consultative selling, cross\-selling, negotiation, and opportunity\-development skills.
* Strong written, verbal, and presentation skills, including comfort presenting to customer leadership.
* Ability to analyze account revenue, service mix, trends, and opportunities using CRM and basic reporting tools.
* Strong organizational skills with disciplined follow\-up and calendar management.
* Valid driver's license, a clean MVR, and ability to travel locally throughout LA Hydro\-Jet's service territory.
* Availability for occasional early\-morning, evening, weekend, customer, or industry events as business needs require.
**What Sets You Apart:**
* Experience in property management, facilities, commercial services, plumbing, HVAC, restoration, waste, construction, or another B2B field\-service industry.
* Experience with property\-management companies, facility teams, restaurants/hospitality groups, multifamily operators, or other multi\-site customers.
* Experience conducting quarterly business reviews (QBRs), account\-planning meetings, or executive customer presentations.
* Experience with ServiceTitan or a comparable CRM/field\-service platform.
* Bachelor's degree in business, marketing, communications, or a related field is preferred but not required in place of strong relevant experience.

### **Role Expectations \& Work Environment**


* This position is expected to spend meaningful time with customers and in the field rather than working exclusively from a desk.
* The role may involve customer\-site visits, office meetings, business meals, industry events, and approved entertainment activities.
* The employee must maintain professional judgment regarding gifts, entertainment, confidentiality, customer policies, and conflicts of interest.
* Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable qualified individuals to perform the essential functions of the role.
* Act as the primary relationship owner when an assigned customer has a complaint, service failure, or escalation.
* Coordinate with Operations and department leadership to understand root cause, corrective action, and customer communication.
* Stay engaged until the customer confirms that the issue has been resolved appropriately.
* Escalate material retention risks or competitive threats promptly to leadership.

### **Required Job Traits**



**Trait**

  

**Why It Matters**

  

**What Strong Performance Looks Like**

  


**Relationship Builder**

  


Creates trust and loyalty with customers.

  


Develops genuine relationships at multiple levels of the account.

  


**Proactive / Self\-Starter**

  


The role cannot depend on inbound calls.

  


Creates reasons to contact customers and advances opportunities without being prompted.

  


**Commercial Mindset**

  


Customer satisfaction alone is not enough.

  


Comfortably asks for additional work and seeks a larger share of customer spend.

  


**Ownership Mentality**

  


Major accounts require clear accountability.

  


Treats account performance as personal responsibility and acts quickly when revenue or satisfaction declines.

  


**Emotional Intelligence**

  


Strategic accounts involve different personalities and pressures.

  


Reads the room, adapts communication, and handles difficult conversations professionally.

  


**Curiosity / Consultative Thinking**

  


Growth comes from understanding customer operations.

  


Asks strong questions about properties, budgets, pain points, vendor structure, and future plans.

  


**Organization / Follow\-Through**

  


Large portfolios create many commitments and touchpoints.

  


Maintains disciplined follow\-up, CRM hygiene, review cadence, and next steps.

  


**Resilience / Persistence**

  


Sales and relationship\-building include rejection and delay.

  


Follows up appropriately withou
