jobs.title: Client Success Specialist
jobs.description:
Fireclay Tile is here to revolutionize the tile and design industry. By implementing an innovative digital platform paired with unmatched artisan\-crafted products and client service, we've made it easier than ever to specify and purchase beautiful, sustainable tile sourced and handcrafted in the US. Our tireless commitment to innovation, transparency, and sustainability has not gone unrecognized. We aim to grow 25\-35% annually and are the first tile company recognized as a B Corp for how we use Business as a Force for Good. With an innovative product, an ambitious team, and an inspiring mission, we're changing the way you think about tile. Come join the makers who support the dreamers!  

We are looking for a passionate, resourceful, and detail\-oriented **Client Success Specialist** to join our team and be the human connection point for our mission — making sure every client feels the intentionality, collaboration, and transparency behind every tile we make, from their very first conversation with us through the life of their project.**The Team You'll Work With …**
-------------------------------


As the Client Success Specialist, you will be an integral part of our Client Success team, working to ensure every client interaction — from first inquiry through post\-installation support — reflects Fireclay's commitment to excellence. As our sales pipeline continues to grow, you'll take full ownership of client\-facing phone, email, text, and chat conversations, giving our sales team the bandwidth to focus on new business while our clients get an even more responsive, dedicated point of contact. This role offers the opportunity to build deep product expertise and grow into a trusted, independent voice for a high volume of client relationships. Reporting to the Client Success Manager, this position is hybrid based out of Aromas, CA (HQ) or select showroom locations (CA, NYC, Chicago, IL, Portland, OR). California\-based candidates preferred; hybrid eligibility required for non\-CA applicants.
Our culture thrives on professional development, ongoing training, and opportunities for growth within the organization. This is an hourly, non\-exempt position and pays $24/hour. **Meet the Hiring Manager,** **Chrissy Bell****!** Born\-and\-raised East Coaster —From NY, to Philly, to CA, to now NC. Chrissy's path into Client Success wasn't a straight line: she spent time in Philly building community at Lululemon and running studio operations at Solidcore before finding her way to Fireclay. Chrissy started here 5 years ago as a Sales Client Support Specialist and has grown into leading our Client Success team — and Chrissy loves that this role means she'll get to help build the next chapter of that story. Her favorite thing about Fireclay is our commitment to the People that keep this company growing (and okay, maybe also all the gorgeous glaze colors). Outside of work, you'll find Chrissy and her husband chasing their 4 year old on the mountain bike trails of Asheville.**What You'll Achieve …**
-------------------------

* Serve as a fully trained, frontline brand ambassador for Fireclay — independently handling the full range of client conversations across phone and email.
* Confidently guide clients through the entire tile\-buying journey, from initial product questions to installation troubleshooting, ensuring a seamless and memorable experience.
* Support our commercial and residential sales teams with data entry, order tracking, logistics coordination, payment processing, and post\-shipment follow\-up — acting as a true extension of the sales team.
* Work closely with our production and warehouse teams to track orders through fulfillment, troubleshoot delays, and keep clients informed every step of the way.
* Use Salesforce.com and Asana to manage client relationships, track conversations, and drive satisfaction across the full client lifecycle.
* Take ownership of a growing volume of client interactions as our sales team scales, becoming the dependable, well\-versed voice our clients count on.

**What We Look For in You …**
-----------------------------


We are looking for someone who is resourceful, personable, and detail\-oriented, with strong follow\-through and a genuine desire to help people. You are excited to build deep tile and design expertise and thrive in a fast\-paced, collaborative environment.* 1\+ years of experience providing excellent customer service (retail, hospitality, call center, or help desk backgrounds all welcome)
* Excellent verbal and written communication skills, with the ability to engage confidently across a wide range of professional groups
* Comfort and confidence independently handling a high volume of email communications and phone calls
* Knowledge of, or a strong desire to learn, tile materials and installation processes for ceramic and glass tile
* Strong computer skills; Salesforce, Front, or Asana experience a plus
* Able to perform the essential functions of this role, with or without reasonable accommodation.
* Strong knowledge and experience with AI to enhance processes.

**Why Fireclay?**
-----------------


Beyond the role itself, here's what makes Fireclay Tile a special place to work:* **Our Mission:** We are on a mission to do good by crafting products intentionally, collaboratively, and transparently. We are the makers, who support the dreamers.
* **Our Values:** We live by Kindness, Honesty, Tread Lightly on the Earth, Measure Twice, Cut Once, and Ganas (Desire).
* **Our Commitment:** We are accountable to the B Corp standards, prioritizing People and Planet alongside Profit.
* **Growth and Innovation:** We are committed to 25\-35% annual growth and are revolutionizing the tile and design industry.
* **Our Culture:** We foster a culture of professional development, ongoing training, and real opportunities for growth within the organization.
* **Our Benefits:** We offer a comprehensive compensation package, including medical, financial, a 4% 40

jobs.title: Marketing Specialist
jobs.description:
**About Hyakunousha**

Hyakunousha (百農社) is the parent company of OMUSUBI, a brand dedicated to connecting people and enriching communities through Japanese culinary culture. Rooted in the tradition of omusubi—a symbol of warmth, care, and nourishment—we are committed to fostering a people\-first, genuinely caring workplace.

As we expand into the United States, our goal is to introduce the heart of Japanese cuisine and the spirit of *omotenashi*: exceptional hospitality delivered with sincerity.

**Position Overview**

The Marketing Officer will play a key role in executing local marketing initiatives and strengthening brand presence in the Los Angeles market. This position is responsible for coordinating marketing campaigns, social media activities, community engagement events, and product launch programs while ensuring alignment with the overall brand strategy developed by the Hong Kong Marketing Team.

The successful candidate is passionate about food, customer experience, and brand building, with the ability to work effectively in a fast\-paced and entrepreneurial environment.

**Key Responsibilities**

**Marketing Campaigns \& Brand Communications**

* Execute local marketing campaigns and promotional activities across online and offline channels.
* Coordinate the implementation of marketing calendars, seasonal promotions, and store\-opening initiatives.
* Work closely with headquarters to ensure brand consistency and effective communication in the U.S. market.
* Coordinate the development and distribution of marketing materials, advertising assets, and promotional content.

**Social Media Management**

* Manage and maintain the brand's social media platforms, including content scheduling, publishing, and community engagement.
* Create and localize social media content that resonates with U.S. consumers.
* Monitor social media trends and identify opportunities to enhance brand visibility and engagement.
* Track performance metrics and provide recommendations to improve campaign effectiveness.

**Events \& Community Marketing**

* Plan, organize, and execute marketing events, store activations, local partnerships, and community outreach programs.
* Coordinate BTL (Below\-the\-Line) marketing activities to drive customer traffic and increase brand awareness.
* Establish relationships with local organizations, influencers, media partners, and community groups.
* Evaluate event performance and identify opportunities for continuous improvement.

**New Product Development (NPD) Support**

* Support the launch and promotion of new products in the U.S. market.
* Gather consumer insights and market intelligence to support product development and marketing strategies.
* Conduct competitor and industry research to identify market opportunities and emerging trends.
* Coordinate marketing support materials for new product launches.

**Customer Experience \& Feedback Management**

* Monitor customer feedback from social media, online review platforms, and other customer touchpoints.
* Work with operations teams to address customer concerns and enhance customer satisfaction.
* Analyze customer feedback trends and provide recommendations for service and product improvements.
* Prepare regular reports on customer sentiment and market insights.

**Reporting \& Administration**

* Track marketing activities and campaign performance against established objectives.
* Coordinate with external vendors, agencies, and partners to ensure timely project execution.
* Monitor marketing budgets and maintain accurate records of expenditures.
* Prepare regular reports and presentations for the Head of Marketing.

**Qualifications**

* Bachelor's degree in Marketing, Communications, Business Administration, or a related discipline.
* Minimum 2 years of experience in marketing, preferably within retail, food \& beverage, hospitality, or consumer brands.
* Experience in social media marketing, event management, and campaign execution.
* Strong organizational and project management skills.
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills.
* Proactive, hands\-on, and results\-oriented mindset.
* Ability to manage multiple projects simultaneously and work independently.
* Proficient in Microsoft Office applications and social media management tools.
* Experience with Canva, Adobe Creative Suite, or similar design tools is an advantage.
* Fluency in English is required. Chinese (Mandarin and/or Cantonese) is a plus.

**What Success Looks Like**

* Increased brand awareness and customer engagement in the Los Angeles market.
* Successful execution of marketing campaigns, events, and product launches.
* Growth in social media audience and engagement metrics.
* Effective collection and utilization of customer feedback to enhance products and services.
* Strong collaboration between U.S. operations and the Hong Kong Marketing Team.

**Our Culture**

At Hyakunousha, we work as ONE TEAM. Our workplace values care, respect, transparency, and collaboration. We encourage creative thinking, cross\-team support, and building a diverse, non\-hierarchical, equitable environment where everyone can grow.

We value passion and integrity over technical perfection.

If you believe in meaningful hospitality and want to grow with a team that cares deeply about people, we’d love to meet you.

**Apply \& Join Our U.S. Launch**

If you’re ready to help bring OMUSUBI by Hyakunousha to Los Angeles, please send your full resume and expected salary to: careers.us@hyakunousha.com

Pay: From $80,000\.00 per year

* Health insurance

* Vision insurance

Cardinal Health’s Global Medical Products and Distribution (“GMPD”) segment, focuses on U.S. and International Products and Distribution businesses. We offer industry expertise and an expanding portfolio of safe, effective medical products that improve quality, manage costs and reduce complexity. With our trusted regulatory experience, insights, and infrastructure, we help manufacture and source medical products that meet the demand for value\-driven, comprehensive healthcare solutions.


**Job Summary**


The **Territory Sales Representative \- Surgery Centers (ASC)** is responsible for securing and maintaining distribution channel as well as growing Cardinal Health Brand and Preferred National Brand products within free\-standing Ambulatory Surgery Centers. The complexity of the solutions, products, and services offered is varied and can range from simple to moderately complex selling and longer sales cycle. The role reports into the Region Director, ASC and it is important that they can build and maintain relationships with key decision makers and potential influencers. Focus areas will include driving new business as well as increasing penetration in existing accounts.

**Responsibilities:**

* Develop and manage successful key relationships within ASC customers to achieve sales goals in assigned territory.
* Responsible for cold calling, prospecting and building relationships that will increase account penetration, revenue growth and customer satisfaction within ASC.
* Collaborates both internally and externally within various business units such as key contacts within national accounts, GPO Reps, and other vendors to archive results.
* Conducts data analytics and analyzes the market penetration on products both in new and existing clients. Responsible for identifying areas for development.
* Coordinates pre\-call planning with sales support staff and delegates data collection to potential other team members.
* Determines prices offered to the client based on client Group Purchasing Agreements, finding suitable and more affordable alternatives if necessary and also determines rebate eligibility.
* Complete all administrative tasks \& training including expense reports, pipeline, maintain accurate SFDC records, market feedback, etc.
* In\-service accounts by demonstrating product applications, functionality and use \- on rare occasions may include the start of a night and weekend shifts
* Attend and participate in sales meetings, training programs, conventions, and trade shows as directed. Attend all regional, divisional and sector events including National Sales Meetings and Region Meetings
* Maintain required sales activity level \- examples include the number of expected visits \& calls, number of products presented/account, etc.
* Assists distribution order support and coordination as needed. Assist customers with back\-orders and other related service issues
* Maintain knowledge of the current industry/competitive landscape including, GPO's, healthcare economics, reimbursement, competitors, competitive products, etc.
* Travel within assigned territory to call on accounts including overnight travel. Maintain active, in\-person presence at top accounts

**Qualifications:**

* Bachelor’s Degree or relevant experience preferred
* Experience in sales, account/relationship management, or customer success preferred
* Strong written and verbal communication skills including active listening, experience in developing and delivering presentations to both small and large groups
* Self\-motivated and proactive with a strong work ethic and a willingness to take initiative
* A critical thinker with a problem\-solving attitude, consistently seeking opportunities to improve processes and resolve issues efficiently
* Possesses a resilient and confident attitude, with the ability to overcome obstacles and maintain a positive outlook
* Technology proficiency with CRM software such as Salesforce and Microsoft Office Suite
* A valid driver's license issued in one of the 50 States with a clean driving record

jobs.title: Inside Sales Representative
jobs.description:
TIMEPROOFUSA was founded by some of the home remodeling industry's most respected leaders. We have quickly become America's fastest\-growing home improvement company—providing roofing solutions to homeowners across the country. Our rapid growth is driven by one mission: to deliver uncompromising quality, dependable service, and lasting peace of mind to every customer we serve.



As a Inside Sales Representative you'll be the voice of TIMEPROOFUSA, connecting with homeowners over the phone and introducing them to our premium roofing solutions. You'll create interest, educate customers on how our products protect and enhance their homes, and schedule qualified appointments for our Sales Representatives — no hard selling, just genuine conversations and strong connections!


**What You'll Do**


* Make outbound calls to homeowners through warm leads — no cold calling from scratch!
* Answer inbound calls to address customer inquiries and deliver exceptional customer service
* Educate prospects by conducting brief, over the phone product demonstrations on TIMEPROOFUSA's roofing services — no pressure selling.
* Qualify interested homeowners and schedule follow\-up appointments for our Sales Representatives.
* Meet and exceed daily/weekly KPIs \- dials per hour, appointments set, conversion rates, etc
* Overcome objections and guide homeowners through the benefits of residential roofing projects


**What's In It for You**


* $21hr \+ bonuses — Top performers earn $25hr–$35hr after bonuses

Full Benefits Package * \- Medical, Dental, Vision, 401k and PTO
* Paid training and mentorship from industry\-leading experts
* Growth opportunities — advance to Senior Caller, Team Lead, Call Center Manager, or Regional Director positions
* High\-energy, supportive team culture built on integrity, recognition, and fun


**What It Takes to Succeed**


* Strong communication skills — clear, upbeat, and confident on the phone.
* Resilient and positive attitude — you can handle objections and keep your energy high.
* Basic computer literacy — comfortable navigating CRMs, phone systems, scripts, and Microsoft office applications
* Ability to submit to and pass a Background Check
* Ability to adapt and thrive in a high call volume environment


**About Us**



TIMEPROOFUSA is redefining the future of roofing. With fire\-safe materials, sustainable technology, and a leadership team backed by decades of success in home remodeling, we're building smarter, safer homes that stand the test of time.



Our core values—People First, Innovation, Customer Obsession, Integrity \& Craftsmanship, and Profit Fuels Our Future—aren't just words on a wall. They drive how we build, lead, and win together.



If you're the kind of person who thrives on challenge, takes pride in excellence, and wants to be part of a team that's changing the industry, this is your moment.



Apply today, take the next step in your career, and let's build something extraordinary together.

jobs.title: Supervisor Clinical Research Coordinator (Orthopedics)
jobs.description:
**Work Location**

Orange, California  

  

**Work Shift**

Day – 08hrs (United States of America)
**Why CHOC?**

At CHOC, we strive to be the leading destination of children’s health by providing exceptional and innovative care. We are responsible for the overall health of our community’s pediatric population in our hospitals, clinics, and practices. And because of our breadth of care, your career at CHOC can be as diverse and fulfilling as you determine. CHOC’s compensation structure, benefits offerings, and career development programs are geared to helping you achieve your professional and personal goals. Apply now to see where your career at CHOC can take you.


**Environmental Sustainability Statement**

Driven by the connection between children's health and a healthy environment, we commit to creating a healthcare model that incorporates environmental sustainability aligned with our mission to protect children's health and patient safety.


**Job Summary**

The Clinical Research Coordinator Supervisor (CRC\-Su) functions independently and is responsible for the complete coordination of multiple assigned human subjects’ (clinical) research projects and is expected to perform all core Clinical Research Coordinator (CRC) responsibilities. The Supervisor serves as a mentor, an educator, and a leader with first\-line supervisory oversight (e.g., involved with hiring, reviewing, and terminating other associates). Study management includes but is not limited to assessing feasibility of clinical research protocols, preparing materials needed for regulatory review and submission to the Institutional Review Board (IRB), identifying potential study participants, coordinating and collecting research data/specimens, completing study records in an accurate and timely manner, participating in quality assurance audits, managing study materials and supplies, communicating across multiple teams, and archiving records in accordance with appropriate policies and procedures. The Supervisor will be responsible for financial components of clinical research projects, documentation of investigator product (drug or device), development of source documents and/or case report forms and running research/project team meetings. In this role, the Supervisor may support investigator\-initiated Investigational New Drug (IND) or Investigational Device Exemption (IDE) applications, monitor or audit studies in the Research Institute, educate and mentor clinical staff, research team members, and other coordinators, and may be requested to coordinate multi\-center studies. The Supervisor is responsible for evaluating CRC performance and assists the Site Manager in resolving operations workload, protocol implementation, and data collection issues. The Supervisor may also participate in one or more workgroups or committees within the Research Institute with a focus on CRC operations. The Supervisor is the most senior position in the Clinical Research Coordinator series.
**Pay Range**

Minimum $90,563 Midpoint $120,016 Maximum $149,427
*Rate of pay is determined by various factors, including but not limited to knowledge, skills, competencies, experience, education, as well as position requirements.*

**Experience**

Required: Minimum six (6\) years of clinical research coordination experience.


Preferred: Clinical research experience in a hospital setting and/or pediatric clinical research experience and demonstrated leadership experience.  



  

**Education**

Required: Bachelor’s degree or equivalent additional experience can be accepted in lieu of education.


Preferred: Master’s degree in a relevant field.


**Specialized Skills**

Required: Working knowledge of key Microsoft Office programs (Word, Excel, PowerPoint). Demonstrate strong interpersonal skills. Able to communicate effectively both orally and in writing. Be detail oriented. Able to work under pressure in a fast\-paced environment while managing multiple competing priorities. jobs.title: Assistant Clinical Research Coordinator - Pediatric CHAMP Program
jobs.description:
The overall goal of the position is to support the developing research enterprises of the Child Health Advanced Molecular Phenotyping (CHAMP) Program, which is designed to help investigators better understand childhood disease by making high\-quality human biological samples and molecular data more accessible across UCSF.


Many serious pediatric illnesses remain difficult to explain using traditional clinical information alone. CHAMP addresses this gap by supporting the careful collection, processing, preservation, and study of biological samples from children across a wide range of diseases and clinical settings. The goal is to make it easier for researchers to connect what is happening in a child's body at the molecular and cellular level with the clinical course of illness.


CHAMP is built around two complementary goals. The first is to create a coordinated infrastructure for collecting biofluids and tissues from willing participants, especially children with severe, rare, or poorly understood diseases. Whenever possible, samples are obtained from the sites most relevant to disease and are processed using protocols designed to preserve their value for both current and future technologies.


The second goal is to pair these samples with advanced molecular profiling platforms that can generate detailed information about immune responses, gene expression, cellular states, antibodies, pathogens, and other features of disease biology. These data can then be used by investigators across UCSF to generate new hypotheses, identify disease mechanisms, and ultimately improve diagnosis and treatment for children.


CHAMP operates under IRB\-approved protocols that allow collection of human biofluids and tissues, including biopsy and post\-mortem specimens, across organ systems and age groups. The program has developed workflows for rapid processing, cryopreservation, and live cell preservation so that valuable samples can be studied with the best available technologies.


The Assistant Clinical Research Coordinator will perform independently or with general direction at the fully operational journey level of the series to execute, manage, and coordinate research protocols, as directed by the Clinical Research Supervisor and/or Principal Investigator (PI); may coordinate the data collection and operations of two concurrent clinical research studies under the guidelines of research protocols, UCSF and regulating agency policies.


Duties may include, but will not be limited to supporting the management and coordinating the tasks of single or multiple clinical research studies, depending on their size and complexity; act as intermediary between services and departments while overseeing data and specimen management; manage and report on study results; create, clean, update, and manage databases and comprehensive datasets and reports; manage Investigator’s protocols in the Committee on Human Research online system, as well as renewals and modifications of protocol applications and the implementation of new studies; participate in the review and writing of protocols to ensure institutional review board approval within University compliance; help assure compliance with all relevant regulatory agencies; oversee study data integrity; implement and maintain periodic quality control procedures; interface with departments to obtain UCSF approval prior to study initiation; maintain all regulatory documents; report study progress to investigators; participate in any internal and external audits or reviews of study protocols; and perform other duties as assigned.


  
Required Qualifications:


* High School Diploma; or equivalent experience
* Excellent verbal and written communications and presentation skills ; excellent organizational skills; and excellent interpersonal skills to work effectively in a diverse team
* Attention to detail; strong interpersonal skills; excellent, effective verbal and written communication skills to coordinate with subjects, team members and outside institutions
* Proficiency with Microsoft Word, PowerPoint, and Windows
* Excellent analytical and problem\-solving skills
* Ability to work effectively in a fast\-paced, team\-based environment; project management and coordination skills; ability to prioritize tasks and meet multiple deadlines on concurrent projects
Ability to establish cooperative working relationships with patients, co\-workers, \& physicians

**Job Summary:**

The Cutaneous Oncology clinical research team supports a diverse portfolio of studies for melanoma and non\-melanoma skin cancers, including squamous cell, basal cell, and Merkel cell carcinomas. The team partners with specialists across Dermatology, Medical Oncology, Surgical Oncology, and Radiation Oncology to provide comprehensive, multidisciplinary care. Our focus includes outpatient, therapeutic cancer clinical trials in phases I–III, including both industry\-sponsored and investigator\-initiated studies. We also manage noninterventional studies aimed at improving early detection, risk assessment, and long\-term survivorship.


The Clinical Research Coordinator (CRC) will independently, or with general direction, execute, manage, and coordinate clinical research protocols, as directed by the Clinical Research Manager, Principal Investigator (PI), and/or the Associate Director of Clinical Research Programs for the Early Phase program. The CRC will coordinate the administrative, data, and patient scheduling operations of several concurrent clinical research studies under the guidelines of research protocols and regulatory policies.


Duties may include, but will not be limited to, supporting the management and coordinating the tasks of single or multiple clinical research studies; managing and updating databases to ensure data integrity; acting as intermediary between sponsors, research staff, and various UCSF departments; help assure compliance with all relevant regulatory agencies;; maintaining relevant regulatory documents in partnership with the Regulatory department; reporting study progress to investigators; participating in any internal and external audits or reviews of study protocols; and performing other duties as assigned.

The UCSF Helen Diller Family Comprehensive Cancer Center (HDFCCC) is one of only two cancer centers in the Bay Area to receive the prestigious designation of “comprehensive” from the National Cancer Institute (NCI).

The Food Programs \& Warehouse Coordinator also provides direct service to beneficiaries, supervises support staff and volunteers, maintains accurate program and inventory records, and assists with program reporting and impact measurement.

**Duties and ResponsibilitiesFood Program Operations**

* Coordinate day\-to\-day operations of Moms Against Poverty’s food assistance programs, including food pantry services and food\-box preparation and distribution.
* Provide direct and respectful service to program beneficiaries, including pantry intake and other required client\-service processes.
* Coordinate the preparation, packing, staging, and distribution of food boxes and other food assistance.
* Help ensure that food boxes and distributions are prepared accurately and consistently according to established program guidelines.
* Support food distribution activities at Moms Against Poverty facilities and other approved community locations.
* Assist with coordinating food availability and allocation among pantry services, food\-box programs, and other distributions.
* Oversee food program operations in the absence of the US Program Manager, as assigned.
* Participate in relevant program, operations, and staff meetings.

**Warehouse \& Inventory Management**

* Oversee the organization, cleanliness, safety, and efficient operation of warehouse and food\-storage areas.
* Receive, inspect, organize, and appropriately store food, in\-kind contributions, and other program supplies.
* Maintain accurate inventory records and ensure inventory is properly allocated to food programs.
* Conduct periodic physical inventory counts and reconcile physical inventory with program records.
* Investigate and resolve inventory discrepancies and maintain appropriate stock levels.
* Monitor expiration, best\-by, and use\-by dates and support appropriate stock rotation practices.
* Organize food and other items according to established storage, safety, and operational procedures.
* Prepare and stage food and supplies for pantry operations, food\-box packing, distributions, and other program activities.
* Coordinate loading and unloading of food, donated goods, and program supplies as needed.
* Monitor food loss, damage, and waste and report significant issues to the US Program Manager.
* Maintain orderly and accessible warehouse and storage areas to support safe and efficient operations.

**Food Safety \& Compliance**

* Follow and help enforce applicable food\-handling, sanitation, storage, and workplace safety procedures.
* Help ensure food is stored, handled, packed, and distributed in accordance with organizational policies and applicable regulatory and partner requirements.
* Monitor the condition and suitability of donated and distributed food.
* Help maintain clean and sanitary pantry, warehouse, packing, and distribution areas.
* Identify and promptly report food\-safety, facility, equipment, or workplace\-safety concerns.

**Staff \& Volunteer Supervision**

* Supervise and support food program and warehouse support staff as assigned.
* Train, supervise, and provide direction to individual and group volunteers.
* Coordinate volunteer activities related to pantry operations, food sorting, food\-box packing, warehouse activities, and distributions.
* Assign responsibilities and help ensure staff and volunteers follow established procedures and safety requirements.
* Foster a respectful, collaborative, and service\-oriented environment for staff, volunteers, beneficiaries, and community partners.

**Program Data, Reporting \& Impact Measurement**

* Collect and maintain accurate food program and operational data.
* Prepare recurring program and operational reports as requested.
* Track key information such as:
* Households and individuals served
* Food boxes prepared and distributed
* Quantity of food distributed
* Pantry participation
* Inventory levels and movement
* Volunteer participation and hours
* Other program impact indicators
* Support program impact evaluation and help ensure that records are complete, accurate, and maintained in accordance with organizational procedures.
* Provide program and operational information needed for internal reporting, donor reporting, grant reporting, and program evaluation as requested.

**General Responsibilities**

* Communicate effectively with staff, volunteers, beneficiaries, community partners, donors, and other stakeholders.
* Support special food distributions, community events, and other program activities as needed.
* Help identify operational challenges and recommend practical solutions to improve efficiency, organization, and service delivery.
* Perform other duties as assigned in support of program and organizational needs.

**Required Qualifications**

* Demonstrated ability to effectively lead, supervise, and work as part of a team.
* Strong interpersonal and verbal communication skills.
* Strong organizational skills and attention to detail.
* Ability to prioritize multiple responsibilities and work effectively in a fast\-paced, hands\-on environment.
* Strong problem\-solving ski

jobs.title: Development Coordinator
jobs.description:
**Reports to:** Executive Director

**Employment Type:** Hourly non\-exempt

**Location:** Onsite at Circus Center (755 Frederick Street, San Francisco)

**Compensation:** $30/hour

**Benefits:** PTO, sick time, commuter benefits, and discounts on classes

**Job Type:** Part\-Time, \~25 hours/week

**Position Summary**

The Development Coordinator is responsible for advancing Circus Center's fundraising, donor relations, grant management, and government contract administration. This role leads the organization's annual end\-of\-year campaign, researches and submits grant applications, manages funder relationships, maintains the donor database, and serves as the primary administrator for the San Francisco Department of Children, Youth, and Their Families (DCYF) contract. The position works closely with the Executive Director, Director of Community Engagement, Marketing Director, Board members, and external partners to support the organization's financial sustainability and mission\-driven goals.

**Key Responsibilities**

Fundraising and Donor Engagement

* Lead the planning and execution of the annual end\-of\-year fundraising campaign, including strategy development, timeline management, and donor segmentation.
* Track fundraising progress and campaign performance against established goals; prepare regular reports for the Executive Director and Board.
* Maintain and strengthen donor relationships through personalized communication, stewardship, and engagement activities.
* Prepare donor acknowledgment letters, impact reports, fundraising updates, and other donor communications.
* Develop materials to support board solicitations and fundraising outreach.
* Assist in the development of long\-term fundraising strategy in collaboration with the Executive Director and Board.

Grants and Sponsorships

* Research and track prospective foundation, corporate, and government funding opportunities aligned with organizational priorities.
* Write, compile, and submit grant applications, proposals, letters of inquiry, and supporting materials.
* Develop grant application budgets in coordination with the Executive Director and accounting consultant.
* Manage grant compliance and reporting, including reimbursement requests for government contracts such as DCYF and Grants for the Arts.
* Serve as the primary point of contact for assigned funders; monitor communications and respond to inquiries in a timely manner.

Database and Administrative Support

* Maintain accurate and complete donor records in the donor management system (Keela).
* Generate reports to track donor profiles, giving history, engagement levels, campaign success, and pledge fulfillment.
* Manage pledge tracking and follow\-up to ensure timely contributions.
* Provide administrative support to the Executive Director as needed for donor relations.

Communications

* Collaborate with the Marketing Director to draft donor\-facing communications, including emails, letters, and campaign materials.
* Prepare and distribute donor correspondence, acknowledgments, and fundraising appeals.

DCYF Contract Administration

* The Development Coordinator serves as the primary administrator for the DCYF contract, ensuring compliance, accurate reporting, and effective coordination across internal and external stakeholders.
* Prepare and submit monthly invoices and reimbursement requests for DCYF\-eligible expenses.
* Gather and organize all invoices and financial documentation for transactions to be allocated to the DCYF contract.
* Communicate with the Fiscal Program Specialist to address questions, provide supporting information, and resolve issues.
* Coordinate with the accounting consultant to obtain general ledger and expense detail; ensure DCYF expense reporting aligns with actual organizational costs.
* Partner with the Director of Community Engagement to develop the DCYF workplan in the Contract Management System (CMS), including key programming, services, projections, performance measures, and program budget.
* Maintain the DCYF Contract Management System (CMS), including updates to the workplan, program activities, and participant data.
* Draft participant forms and coordinate with partner sites to collect required participant data for group activities.
* Work with the Director of Community Engagement, Executive Director, accountant, and other staff to compile records and documentation for fiscal compliance reviews.
* Coordinate with program sites to align programming dates, confirm site contracts, and ensure consistent communication regarding scheduling and activity details.

**Qualifications**

Required Qualifications

● Experience: 2\-3 years of professional experience in a nonprofit development, fundraising, or grant writing role

● Grant \& Fundraising Skills: Proven experience in writing, submitting, and managing grants from foundations, corporations, and government entities, including compliance and reporting

● Technical Skills: Strong skills in Microsoft Office Suite (Word, Excel, Outlook)

● Communication Skills: Excellent written and verbal communication skills for drafting proposals, donor correspondence, and reports, and for building relationships with funders

● Organizational Skills: Strong organizational and time\-management skills to manage multiple projects with competing deadlines, such as the end\-of\-year campaign and various grant cycles.

**Preferred Qualifications**

● Education: A Bachelor's degree in a related field such as Communications, Nonprofit Management, Business, or English

● Government Contract Experience: Experience administering a government contract or grant, specifically in managing compliance, invoicing, and reporting requirements

● Specific Industry Knowledge: Experience working in a performing arts, arts education, or similarly mission\-driven nonprofit organization

● Database Management: Previous experience with the Keela platform or a similar CRM used for donor tracking and reporting

● Budgeting

jobs.title: Client Services Coordinator
jobs.description:
**Position Summary**


The Client Services Coordinator supports the Ophthalmic Society \& Global Relations team by coordinating and administering programs and operations for managed society and SF Match clients. Serving as a primary point of contact for applicants, training programs, medical schools, managed societies, members, and other customers, this role provides responsive service by phone, email, and in person; processes applications and required documentation; maintains accurate databases and records; supports enrollment, registration, and renewal activities; and escalates service issues to management when appropriate. The coordinator also contributes to program, meeting, interview, and event logistics while helping identify opportunities to improve workflows and service delivery.

**Role and Responsibilities**

**1\. Client Support**

* Manage assigned client programs and projects.
* Support new projects and workflow improvements in collaboration with management and team members.
* Complete and maintain required client documentation.
* Maintain website content as assigned and review content against requirements, reporting inconsistencies as directed.
* Produce e\-blast layouts and distributions.
* Create, extract, and produce data or spreadsheet reports for approved projects, studies, or client needs.
* Contact clients for follow\-up information and relay relevant information to the appropriate internal teams as directed.
**2\. Customer Relations**

* Support customers and members by email, phone, and in person, researching questions to provide accurate responses.
* Serve as the primary and initial point of contact for inquiries.

* Coordinate and assist with multiple databases simultaneously, including data entry and updates, payments and revenue processing, registration, dues, products, record updates, and prescribed data\-cleanup procedures.

* Manage product and meeting builds.
* Recommend strategies for improved processes and procedures.
* Support accounting\-related tasks, including processing and closing batches.
**4\. Enrollment \& Renewal Management**

* Manage renewal and enrollment processes for client programs, including membership, registration, or match participation, as applicable.
* Produce meeting, membership, financial, and product inventory reports.

* Coordinate and oversee membership application processes.

**Qualifications, Skills, and Education Requirements**

* Strong administrative and customer service experience, with professional verbal and written communication skills and the ability to work effectively with leadership, staff, member volunteers, applicants, customers, and external partners.
* Experience with database maintenance and record keeping, report preparation, data accuracy, project coordination, and managing a high volume of detailed work; ability to protect confidential client and match\-related information is essential.
* Proficiency with Microsoft Office Suite and Adobe Acrobat Professional; experience creating reports in Excel and working with database or CRM platforms such as Personify or Salesforce is valuable. Experience with website maintenance, electronic surveys, listservs, or e\-blasts is beneficial.
* Previous experience with nonprofit membership associations, the meeting industry, academic medicine, residency recruitment, or other public\-facing service environments is preferred. Bachelor's degree preferred, or two years of equivalent experience.
* Ability to work a San Francisco hybrid schedule (40\-60% in office) and travel to 2\-5 out\-of\-state meetings per year, including weekend travel; trips generally range from 3 to 8 days.
**Compensation and Benefits**
-----------------------------

**Salary: $83,404 annually**


Salary listed reflects compensation for San Francisco\-based hybrid employees. Compensation may vary based on geographic location, experience, and internal equity considerations.

jobs.title: Recruiting Coordinator
jobs.description:
### **Role Summary**


Are you an organized, collaborative Human Resources professional who thrives in a fast\-paced environment? We are seeking an engaging Talent Acquisition Coordinator to support our Talent Management team with full\-cycle recruiting and onboarding operations! In this key role, you will work under the direction of the Talent Acquisition Manager and partner directly with Talent Acquisition Specialists, Recruiters, and hiring managers. You will manage the new hire experience from offer acceptance through initial onboarding and New Hire Orientation (NHO). Additionally, you will oversee Applicant Tracking System (ATS) operations, process requisition workflows, track recruiting expenses, and facilitate manager hiring trainings. If you are passionate about delivering top\-tier customer service, managing HR data with accuracy, and creating a seamless candidate journey, this position offers an inspiring opportunity to grow your HR career!

### **Duties \& Responsibilities**

#### **Candidate Onboarding \& Orientation**

* Serve as the primary liaison to new hires following offer acceptance, ensuring consistent and complete pre\-onboarding communication.
* Ensure all hiring forms and onboarding requirements are fully completed prior to the new team member's first day.
* Facilitate New Hire Orientation (NHO), including coordinating all logistics to prepare and finalize the orientation program.
* Manage e\-filing systems and oversee the creation of compliant electronic employee files.
* Cross\-train regularly on basic HR partner responsibilities to support clients as needed, including managing Day 1 Onboarding workflows (e.g., completing the Form I\-9 process and collecting required paperwork).
* Own newly opened or aged requisitions from inception through closure.
* Conduct requisition intake reviews for accuracy, manage timely approvals, consult with hiring managers, and coordinate with recruiters for job board postings.
* Serve as the primary point of contact to recruiters and participate in weekly recruiting calls to review search status, interview progress, and filled roles.
* Review and process Offer Authorization Request forms through required HR approval steps.
* Conduct compensation research, recommend rates as needed, track declined offers due to pay, and share data anomalies with the Compensation and Recruiting teams.
* Ensure all candidate applications are properly dispositioned and filled requisitions are closed in a timely manner.
* Manage and maintain the Applicant Tracking System (ATS)—ensuring data accuracy, cleanliness, and timely website postings, while recommending process enhancements.
* Perform accurate data entry into the Human Resources Information System (HRIS).
* Facilitate training sessions for hiring managers, recruiters, and interview panels to ensure consistent, legal, and fair applicant evaluation processes.
* Review and code monthly vendor invoices and maintain the central Recruiting expense tracker.
* Maintain regular communication with key internal and external stakeholders regarding search progress and priorities.
* Help plan, execute, and participate in community recruiting events.
* Document and maintain Talent Acquisition policies and procedures to ensure compliance with applicable employment laws and regulations.
* Participate in special HR projects and initiatives as assigned.
* Other duties as assigned.

### **Required Qualifications**

#### **Education \& Experience**

* **Education:** High School Diploma or GED equivalent.
* **Work Experience:** Minimum of two (2\) or more years of related Human Resources and/or office administration experience.

#### **Key Skills \& Abilities**

* **Language Skills:** Proficiency in English paired with bilingual fluency (verbal and written) in eithe**r Chinese or Spanish.**
* **Software Proficiency:** Proficient computer skills, including Microsoft Word and Excel; experience maintaining data accurately in an HRIS and Applicant Tracking System (ATS).
* **Organizational \& Prioritization Skills:** Exceptional organizational skills, strong attention to detail, and proven prioritization abilities to manage multi\-task demands in a fast\-paced setting.
* **Communication \& Interpersonal Skills:** Excellent written, verbal, and phone communication skills with stellar customer service capabilities for every internal and external partner.
* **Problem\-Solving \& Discretion:** Strong administrative problem\-solving skills, critical thinking, initiative, and the ability to handle confidential details and ambiguity.
* **Event Logistics \& Teamwork:** Experience in event/meeting planning, participation, and facilitation, with a strong comfort level working within a collaborative team.

### **Desired Qualifications**

* Experience with recruiting expense tracking, invoice processing, or HR compliance documentation.
* Prior experience delivering or supporting manager\-level HR training modules.

### **Location and Work Type**

* **Work Type:** Full\-Time, Non\-Exempt Position (40 hours per week).
* **Work Setting:** Hybrid Model (2 days per week on\-site)
* **Schedule:** Monday through Friday, 8:00 AM – 4:30 PM.
* **Physical \& Travel Requirements:** Occasional local travel within the SF Bay Area (up to 25 lbs. lifting capability required for recruiting event setup).

**If you're interested, please reply to this advertisement or directly email your resume to me at DSalgado@teemagroup.com or by calling/texting (949\) 295\-5951\.**  

**I strive to reply within 48 hours. Looking forward to connecting with you soon. Thank you!**


\#Workwolf

By recognizing that our destinies are tied, we continue to name that all things are fundamentally connected, and the overlap between ecology, race, gender, and representative government will move to either advance our collective humanity or to oppress it. Sierra Club has close to 700 staff across the country and a network of 64 local chapters that are led and fueled by thousands of volunteers. We are also proud to be a unionized employer, with three labor unions representing more than half of our employees.  


**Scope:** Under direct supervision from the Director, Membership Operations, the Membership Operations Coordinator will be responsible for preparing all donations received in the Oakland office for processing and depositing. This is an on\-site position that requires opening and sorting incoming mail in the Oakland office, entering the donor information into the Customer Relationship Management (CRM) database (currently Salesforce), and working with the Sierra Club Finance Department to ensure the donations are deposited. The position is vital to help speed up the process and deposit major gift donations.

* Works with Chapter staff and volunteers on processing their donations.


* Tracks and sends back checks that are unable to be processed.


* Performs miscellaneous data entry tasks that include but are not limited to: coding returned mail, fulfilling personal mail requests, processing check donations entered by the Sierra Club Finance Department, and processing credit card donations mailed to the Oakland office.


* Researches and prepares special projects and reports, using various word processing and spreadsheet applications. Reports on regular performance indicators to management, by monitoring reports of external vendors and flagging key indicators.


* Serves as a contact person for Chapters to process c3 donations. Handles incoming checks, ensuring that they are uploaded to the external caging vendor or given to Foundation staff if the check requires special handling. jobs.title: Account Manager
jobs.description:
**About Alex**
--------------


Alex is the AI recruiter for hiring great people.


Alex interviews, screens, and schedules every candidate – over voice, video, and text – so talent teams hire more great people, faster, without adding TA headcount. The recruiter stays in control: every shortlist is approved by a human, and every relationship and offer is owned by the customer's team.


We're past 1M\+ interviews, integrate with 33\+ ATS platforms, and 96% of candidates prefer interviewing with Alex. We're revenue\-generating, well\-funded, backed by premier investors, and are focused on enterprise customers: selling to VPs of Talent Acquisition, CHROs, and CFOs at large employers who are rethinking how hiring gets done at scale.

**About the Role**
------------------


Every Alex account is run by a pair. A Forward\-Deployed Engineer owns the technical deployment — the ATS integration, the workflows, the support queue. You own the relationship and the revenue. You're joining the AM team early, and your input will shape the function. This role is based in office in San Francisco.


You'll carry a book of accounts: retaining and growing revenue, deepening the relationship, and finding the strategic expansion paths.

* **Own NRR for your book** — renewals end to end, plus the upsells and expansions that grow an account past its initial booking.
* **Multi\-thread the relationship** — exec sponsors, champions, and the recruiters using Alex daily, so a single departure doesn't take the account with it.
* **Drive adoption** — onboard users, run trainings, and watch usage closely enough to spot which teams need a nudge before it surfaces in a renewal.
* **Build the business case, inside and out** — arm your champion to sell Alex to their own leadership, then turn those wins into case studies that help close the next deal.
* **Lead QBRs with business stakeholders**, using usage data and our roadmap to open expansion paths. Set success criteria at kickoff so renewals confirm next steps rather than force them.
* **Work the pair with engineering** — route technical asks to your FDE rather than absorbing them, and pass expansion signals back the other way.

**About You**
-------------

* 5\+ years in Account Management, Customer Success with a revenue number, or an AE carrying a renewal and expansion book, at a SaaS company. You can name the target you carried and how you hit it.
* You've owned renewals end to end — timeline, pricing, negotiation, close — and you're comfortable asking for money.
* You've gotten a customer's team to change how they work, not just gotten a contract signed.
* Credible with executives and with recruiters on the same day.
* Technically fluent, not technically hands\-on: you can hold a real conversation about an ATS integration and know when to bring in your FDE.
* A data\-driven storyteller: you act on usage metrics before a renewal is at risk, and turn a customer win into collateral that helps win the next one.
* A commercially confident builder: you'd rather have the pricing conversation early than let it sit, and you’re excited to build playbooks for this function at you go.
* Bonus: experience at a high\-growth startup.


This might not be the role for you if you prefer a support role without a number attached, or you don't want to work in person. We're in office in SF 5 days a week.

**What's in it for you?**
-------------------------

* Shape the foundation of our Account Management org, with an engineer paired with you on every account you run.
* Competitive compensation, equity, and growth potential.
* Medical, dental, and vision insurance, unlimited PTO, company\-paid team lunches, a beautiful office in SF, and great company events.


If you've gotten this far and our culture resonates with you, we want you to apply. Your first conversation will be with Alex, our AI recruiter.


Compensation Range: $150K \- $200K

jobs.description:
**About Betterworks**


Betterworks is HR software to align, develop, and activate your workforce for business growth. Organizations are able to replace outdated, ineffective, universally loathed annual review processes with powerful Continuous Performance Management programs that help managers be better at the conversations, coaching, and development necessary to inspire and motivate the entire workforce to achieve an organization's top priorities today and be ready for tomorrow's challenges.


At Betterworks, we are dedicated to ensuring our customers' success by delivering exceptional experiences, results, and business value throughout their journey with us. We are seeking an experienced and results\-driven **Support Account Manager** to join our team. In this pivotal role, you will be the key driver of signature support and service experiences for a select group of customers who have invested in our Signature Support Account Management offering.

**This is an East Coast, US remote opportunity!**

**The Opportunity**


As a Support Account Manager, you will be a strategic partner to the Customer Success team, managing the ongoing product support relationship for up to 5 Betterworks customers throughout their entire lifecycle. Your mission will be to drive the adoption and technical success of the Betterworks solution, acting as the primary point of contact for all product support issues. You will collaborate with the product and engineering teams to resolve challenges, refine configurations, and enhance the value customers derive from our platform.


In addition to product \& technical support, you will assist customers with ongoing configuration needs, survey design, and the creation of custom in\-product guides tailored to support their unique Betterworks programs.

**What You Own**

* **Own the customer support relationship:** Act as the dedicated product support partner for assigned customers, collaborating closely with the Customer Success team to ensure customer satisfaction and success.
* **Drive product adoption and value:** Help customers realize the full potential of the Betterworks solution by facilitating adoption, improving product usage, and advancing their technical maturity.
* **Collaborate with Program Architects:** During implementation and beyond, work closely with Program Architects to understand and refine each customer's Betterworks configuration as their program evolves.
* **Troubleshoot and escalate product issues:** Provide expert support on product functionality, recommend solutions, and escalate complex issues to the Product Management and Engineering teams as needed.
* **Manage customer support queue:** Deliver timely and prioritized support responses, ensuring that customer queries are handled efficiently and effectively.
* **Design and maintain custom in\-product guides:** Become an expert in creating, maintaining, and evolving custom in\-product guides to meet the specific needs of each customer’s Betterworks program.
* **Support the broader customer base:** As needed, assist the Customer Success team by addressing day\-to\-day product questions and challenges that benefit a wider audience.

**What You Bring**


We’re seeking a highly motivated individual with a passion for customer success, strong technical aptitude, and excellent communication skills. The ideal candidate thrives in a fast\-paced environment, has experience managing complex customer relationships, and is comfortable explaining sophisticated technical concepts in simple terms.

**Required Qualifications:**

* 3\-5 years of experience in Support or Technical Account Management serving Enterprise or Strategic accounts.
* Experience within the Performance Management or OKR markets is a plus.
* Exceptional written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to translate complex technical ideas into clear, actionable insights for non\-technical stakeholders.
* Proven track record of managing multiple priorities and meeting tight deadlines while maintaining high productivity.
* Demonstrated ability to build strong, lasting relationships with key customer stakeholders, driving mutual success and long\-term results.
* Deep understanding of the latest trends in customer service, metrics, and technology.
* Experience with tools such as Jira, Zendesk, SQL, and remote assistance products.
* Prior experience with Pendo or other custom\-guide development software is a plus

All employees have a responsibility for reporting information security incidents in accordance with information security policies and procedures.

jobs.title: Automotive Operations Specialist
jobs.description:
**Company Description**  

MSX has been a trusted partner to leading vehicle manufacturers, their retailers, and mobility organizations globally for more than 30 years. Our unwavering commitment is to help our clients transform their businesses and effectively manage operations in the areas of Sales Performance; Repair Optimization and Compliance; Parts and Accessories Sales Performance; and Consumer Engagement. With our global teams, industry expertise, and the power of technology, we design and deliver tailored, sustainable, and innovative solutions and services that help our clients optimize their operations and captivate their customers.

 **Job Description**  

MSX International is seeking an Operations Specialist who will evaluate current dealer fixed operations, identify inefficiencies, and recommend areas for performance improvement. You will work closely with dealer staff to coach and mentor them on sales techniques and customer service standards to ensure the delivery of Dealer and OEM Business Plan Objectives. You will monitor dealer progress, recap actions taken, and recommend best practices to enhance customer experience. Additionally, you will track and report key performance metrics, identifying areas for improvement and celebrating successes.

**Key Responsibilities:**

* Evaluate current dealer operations to identify inefficiencies, gaps, and opportunities for performance improvement.
* Coach and mentor dealer staff on sales techniques and customer service standards to achieve Dealer Business Plans and Ford objectives.
* Monitor dealer progress between support actions, providing ongoing feedback and support.
* Accurately document actions taken and provide recommendations from on\-site support visits.
* Implement best practices in customer service and sales techniques to enhance the overall customer experience.
* Track and report key performance metrics, identifying areas for improvement and celebrating successes.
* Collaborate with dealership management to develop and implement action plans for continuous improvement.

 **Qualifications*** Proven experience in dealer or aftermarket automotive service operations.
* Strong coaching and mentoring skills with the ability to motivate and develop dealer staff.
* Excellent analytical skills to evaluate performance metrics and identify areas for improvement.
* Strong communication and interpersonal skills to build effective relationships with dealer staff and management.
* Ability to travel to dealer locations for on\-site support and evaluations.
* Knowledge of dealer fixed operations and business objectives.
* Experience implementing customer service best practices and sales techniques.
* Ability to work independently and manage multiple priorities.
* Ability to leverage relationships to identify and sell the business case for change.
* Analyzing data from dealer financials and operational assessments to establish improvement action plans.
* Demonstrated proficiency with PC applications in a Windows environment.
* Ability to influence the sales personnel and technicians in the training processes and monitor the results.
* Bachelor's Degree (preferred) but High school diploma or General Equivalency Diploma (GED) is required

 **Additional Information**  

The wage range for this role takes into account the wide range of factors that are considered in making compensation decisions including but not limited to skill sets, experience and training, and other business and organizational needs. The disclosed range estimate may not have been adjusted for the applicable geographic differential associated with the location at which the position may be filled. At MSXi, it is not typical for an individual to be hired at the top of the range for their role and compensation decisions are dependent on the facts and circumstances of each case. A reasonable estimate of the current annual range is $65k to $78k based on current experience


MSX International is an Equal Employment Opportunity Employer committed to employing a diverse workforce. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, gender identity, disability and protected veteran status, age, or any other characteristic protected by law.

jobs.title: Client Success Specialist
jobs.description:
Fireclay Tile is here to revolutionize the tile and design industry. By implementing an innovative digital platform paired with unmatched artisan\-crafted products and client service, we've made it easier than ever to specify and purchase beautiful, sustainable tile sourced and handcrafted in the US. Our tireless commitment to innovation, transparency, and sustainability has not gone unrecognized. We aim to grow 25\-35% annually and are the first tile company recognized as a B Corp for how we use Business as a Force for Good. With an innovative product, an ambitious team, and an inspiring mission, we're changing the way you think about tile. Come join the makers who support the dreamers!  

We are looking for a passionate, resourceful, and detail\-oriented **Client Success Specialist** to join our team and be the human connection point for our mission — making sure every client feels the intentionality, collaboration, and transparency behind every tile we make, from their very first conversation with us through the life of their project.**The Team You'll Work With …**
-------------------------------


As the Client Success Specialist, you will be an integral part of our Client Success team, working to ensure every client interaction — from first inquiry through post\-installation support — reflects Fireclay's commitment to excellence. As our sales pipeline continues to grow, you'll take full ownership of client\-facing phone, email, text, and chat conversations, giving our sales team the bandwidth to focus on new business while our clients get an even more responsive, dedicated point of contact. This role offers the opportunity to build deep product expertise and grow into a trusted, independent voice for a high volume of client relationships. Reporting to the Client Success Manager, this position is hybrid based out of Aromas, CA (HQ) or select showroom locations (CA, NYC, Chicago, IL, Portland, OR). California\-based candidates preferred; hybrid eligibility required for non\-CA applicants.
Our culture thrives on professional development, ongoing training, and opportunities for growth within the organization. This is an hourly, non\-exempt position and pays $24/hour. **Meet the Hiring Manager,** **Chrissy Bell****!** Born\-and\-raised East Coaster —From NY, to Philly, to CA, to now NC. Chrissy's path into Client Success wasn't a straight line: she spent time in Philly building community at Lululemon and running studio operations at Solidcore before finding her way to Fireclay. Chrissy started here 5 years ago as a Sales Client Support Specialist and has grown into leading our Client Success team — and Chrissy loves that this role means she'll get to help build the next chapter of that story. Her favorite thing about Fireclay is our commitment to the People that keep this company growing (and okay, maybe also all the gorgeous glaze colors). Outside of work, you'll find Chrissy and her husband chasing their 4 year old on the mountain bike trails of Asheville.**What You'll Achieve …**
-------------------------

* Serve as a fully trained, frontline brand ambassador for Fireclay — independently handling the full range of client conversations across phone and email.
* Confidently guide clients through the entire tile\-buying journey, from initial product questions to installation troubleshooting, ensuring a seamless and memorable experience.
* Support our commercial and residential sales teams with data entry, order tracking, logistics coordination, payment processing, and post\-shipment follow\-up — acting as a true extension of the sales team.
* Work closely with our production and warehouse teams to track orders through fulfillment, troubleshoot delays, and keep clients informed every step of the way.
* Use Salesforce.com and Asana to manage client relationships, track conversations, and drive satisfaction across the full client lifecycle.
* Take ownership of a growing volume of client interactions as our sales team scales, becoming the dependable, well\-versed voice our clients count on.

**What We Look For in You …**
-----------------------------


We are looking for someone who is resourceful, personable, and detail\-oriented, with strong follow\-through and a genuine desire to help people. You are excited to build deep tile and design expertise and thrive in a fast\-paced, collaborative environment.* 1\+ years of experience providing excellent customer service (retail, hospitality, call center, or help desk backgrounds all welcome)
* Excellent verbal and written communication skills, with the ability to engage confidently across a wide range of professional groups
* Comfort and confidence independently handling a high volume of email communications and phone calls
* Knowledge of, or a strong desire to learn, tile materials and installation processes for ceramic and glass tile
* Strong computer skills; Salesforce, Front, or Asana experience a plus
* Able to perform the essential functions of this role, with or without reasonable accommodation.
* Strong knowledge and experience with AI to enhance processes.

**Why Fireclay?**
-----------------


Beyond the role itself, here's what makes Fireclay Tile a special place to work:* **Our Mission:** We are on a mission to do good by crafting products intentionally, collaboratively, and transparently. We are the makers, who support the dreamers.
* **Our Values:** We live by Kindness, Honesty, Tread Lightly on the Earth, Measure Twice, Cut Once, and Ganas (Desire).
* **Our Commitment:** We are accountable to the B Corp standards, prioritizing People and Planet alongside Profit.
* **Growth and Innovation:** We are committed to 25\-35% annual growth and are revolutionizing the tile and design industry.
* **Our Culture:** We foster a culture of professional development, ongoing training, and real opportunities for growth within the organization.
* **Our Benefits:** We offer a comprehensive compensation package, including medical, financial, a 4% 40

jobs.title: Sales Operations Admin I
jobs.description:
**Who we are**



Samsara (NYSE: IOT) is the pioneer of the Connected Operations™ Cloud, which is a platform that enables organizations that depend on physical operations to harness Internet of Things (IoT) data to develop actionable insights and improve their operations. At Samsara, we are helping improve the safety, efficiency and sustainability of the physical operations that power our global economy. Representing more than 40% of global GDP, these industries are the infrastructure of our planet, including agriculture, construction, field services, transportation, and manufacturing — and we are excited to help digitally transform their operations at scale.



Working at Samsara means you'll help define the future of physical operations and be on a team that's shaping an exciting array of product solutions, including Video\-Based Safety, Vehicle Telematics, Apps and Driver Workflows, and Equipment Monitoring. As part of a recently public company, you'll have the autonomy and support to make an impact as we build for the long term.

**About the role:**  


Samsara is looking for a Sales Operations Admin to play a critical role in scaling systems, processes and policies for our Enterprise Sales organizations. This role will partner with senior leaders across Samsara's go\-to\-market teams to design, build and run critical business capabilities for our world\-class sales organization. This leader will have an outsized impact on the future of our sales organization by helping us Build for The Long Term as we grow beyond $1BN in revenue. The ideal candidate has experience driving transformative initiatives that bring together people, process and technology into elegant solutions to business problems related to all aspects of the sales experience.  


**This is a remote position open to candidates residing in the US.**  


**You should apply if:**
* **You want to impact the industries that run our world:** Your efforts will result in real\-world impact—helping to keep the lights on, get food into grocery stores, and most importantly, ensure workers return home safely.
* **You have innate curiosity in how businesses work:** One day you'll meet with someone in waste management and the next you may be learning about the inner workings of a food distribution center. Our top sales team members seek to learn the ins and outs of the businesses they support in order to make a larger impact.
* **You build genuine relationships with your customers:** The industries we serve have relied on pen\-and\-paper solutions for years and haven't been met with the type of technology we offer. Our customers value earned trust and human relationships built over time.
* **You want to be with the best:** Samsara's high\-performance culture means you'll be surrounded by the best and challenged to go farther than you have before.
* **You are a team player:** At Samsara, sales is a team sport. We help each other out by sharing best practices and focus on winning as a team.


**In this role, you will:**
* Partner closely with Manager to VP\-level Sales Leadership to optimize our Enterprise Sales motion, ensuring scalable, efficient processes that drive ACV, retention and expansion.
* Lead large cross\-functional programs focused on improving Sales outcomes, including process redesign, tooling enhancements, and analytics\-driven improvements.
* Intake, assess, and prioritize Sales\-specific requests and process gaps based on business impact and effort, developing a roadmap aligned to core Sales goals.
* Develop and maintain operational metrics that uncover inefficiencies or risks within the seller workflow; provide actionable insights and partner with cross\-functional teams to implement solutions.
* Collaborate with Salesforce Systems and RevOps teams to enhance automation, deliver scalable tooling, define business requirements, conduct UAT, and manage end\-user communications..
* Champion, role model, and embed Samsara's cultural principles (Focus on Customer Success, Build for the Long Term, Adopt a Growth Mindset, Be Inclusive, Win as a Team) as we scale globally and across new offices.


**Minimum requirements for the role:**
* 6\+ years of experience in Sales Operations roles supporting cross\-functional sales organizations within a fast\-paced, iterative, forward\-thinking SaaS environment.
* This is a high impact position with high internal visibility that requires strong priority management and high emotional intelligence
* Proven ability to drive improvements in Sales workflows through cross\-functional project management and build long\-term solutions.
* Advanced in Excel.
* Advanced in Salesforce.com and proficient in sales tech stack tools.
* Strong organizational skills and business judgment with a track record of leading complex projects from strategy through execution.
* Analytical mindset and ability to use data to influence sales strategy and decision\-making.
* Excellent communication skills and experience translating policy/process into field\-facing resources and guidance.
* Bachelor's degree from a top university; focus in business, finance, economics, or engineering preferred. MBA optional.
* Salesforce Administration Experience is a plus but not required.

**Total Rewards**



At Samsara, we build for the people who keep the global economy moving. We want owners, not passengers, which is why our rewards are designed to fuel high\-impact builders. Our compensation program delivers above\-market total compensation through a combination of base salary, performance\-based bonus/variable pay, and equity (for eligible roles) in a high\-growth public company. **Position:** Customer Success Manager (Senior and Junior openings available)

**Location:** San Francisco, CA

**Length:** Permanent

**Ideally looking for:** Prior experience at GTM Sales company, experience establishing playbooks / building out CS function

**The Opportunity**


As a Customer Success Manager, you'll serve as a strategic partner to customers, helping them get maximum value from an AI\-native CRM and broader revenue platform.


You'll own relationships across a portfolio of high\-value customers and be responsible for driving adoption, engagement, retention, and expansion. The role sits at the intersection of customer strategy, product expertise, and hands\-on execution. You'll work closely with customers to understand their goals, translate those goals into measurable success plans, and ensure they continue seeing meaningful value from the platform over time.


The company is still very much in build mode and places a strong emphasis on working together in person. This role is expected to be in the San Francisco office five days per week.

* Own Customer Relationships
* Serve as the primary post\-sales partner for a portfolio of customers, building trusted relationships with day\-to\-day users, key stakeholders, and executive sponsors.
* Drive Adoption and Customer Value
* Help customers get deeper value from the platform by increasing adoption across teams, workflows, and product modules. Lead regular strategy and success reviews focused on ROI, usage, and business outcomes.
* Build and Execute Success Plans
