jobs.title: Project Manager - Digital Marketing & Ecommerce Agency
jobs.description:
You are the person who keeps things moving.

You know what needs to happen, who needs to do it, and when it needs to be done. You take notes because details matter. You follow up because deadlines matter. And you don't wait until something becomes a problem to address it.

You are organized without being rigid, direct without being difficult, and comfortable holding people accountable. When several projects are moving at once, you don't get overwhelmed — you create structure.

If that sounds like you, we'd like to meet you.

**About Us**

We are a growing boutique digital marketing agency based in downtown Manhattan, working with brands across food, fashion, health \& beauty, ecommerce and emerging consumer categories.

Our work spans ecommerce, content development, SEO, paid media, email marketing, and digital strategy.

We are a small, hands\-on team. That means everyone has an impact, ideas are welcome.

We are looking for a full\-time, in\-person Project Manager who can become a central part of our team and help make the agency run better every day.

**The Role**

As Project Manager, you will be at the center of our client work, coordinating projects across creative, web design, ecommerce optimization, email, and paid media.

Your job is simple to describe but challenging to do well: keep the work organized, keep the team aligned, and keep projects moving forward.

You will have visibility across multiple clients and projects simultaneously, making sure priorities are clear, resources are coordinated, deadlines are planned, and deliverables are completed accurately and on time.

You won't simply update project management software. We want someone who understands the work, anticipates what comes next, identifies problems early and actively helps the team solve them.

**What You'll Do**

* Manage multiple client projects, deliverables and timelines simultaneously
* Build and maintain clear project briefs and schedules
* Make sure every client deliverable is accounted for in our project management system
* Coordinate priorities, resources and dependencies across the team
* Follow up proactively with team members and hold people accountable to deadlines
* Identify potential delays, bottlenecks and risks before they become problems
* Communicate project status clearly to the internal team
* Help prioritize workloads when multiple projects compete for resources
* Ensure established workflows and Standard Operating Procedures are followed
* Recommend improvements to our processes and SOPs
* Help us continually make the agency more organized, efficient and effective

**What We're Looking For**

* 3\+ years of project management experience, preferably within a creative, digital, advertising or marketing agency
* Experience managing multiple complex projects and deadlines concurrently
* Bachelor's degree or equivalent professional experience
* Exceptional organizational skills and attention to detail
* Strong written and interpersonal communication skills
* Confidence following up, asking questions and holding people accountable
* Ability to remain calm and solutions\-oriented when priorities change
* Strong sense of ownership and personal accountability
* Comfortable working in a fast\-moving, collaborative environment
* Experience with Asana and Google Workspace
* Familiarity with Shopify and Klaviyo is strongly preferred
* Strong working knowledge of AI tools such as ChatGPT and Claude, including using AI for research, organization, problem\-solving and productivity

**You'll Probably Love This Role If...**

You like checking things off a list.

You notice when something is missing before anyone else does.

You'd rather ask "Where are we on this?" today than discover tomorrow that something is late.

You enjoy creating order from a lot of moving pieces.

You're passionate about ecommerce, digital marketing, technology and AI, and you genuinely enjoy learning as they evolve.

And you're looking for a place where you can contribute ideas, improve how things are done and make a visible difference.

Bonus points if you are also a creative and conceptual thinker who enjoys brainstorming ideas, thinking strategically and helping turn a vision into something the team can execute.

**One Important Thing**

This is not a passive project management position.

We aren't looking for someone whose job ends with updating Asana. We are looking for someone who takes ownership, asks questions, follows through and helps the entire team do better work.

If you see yourself in this description, we'd love to hear from you.

Tell us a little about yourself, your project management experience, and why you think you'd be a good fit for our team.

This is a full\-time, in\-person position based in downtown Manhattan, with significant opportunity to learn, grow and take on greater responsibility as our agency grows.

Job Type: Full\-time

Pay: $25\.00 per hour

Benefits:

* Health insurance
* Paid time off

Compensation Package:

* Bonus opportunities

Application Question(s):

* Q1: Some people keep lists to make sure things are done in order, while others keep lists so that they do not forget. How would you classify yourself? Can you give examples of the way you manage?
* Q2: Can you describe a time when you had to set priorities? What was your focus and what was the outcome?
* Q3: How do you balance between making sure details are correct and making sure projects are done at an efficient rate? What are the problems you have faced in making sure items are accurate? Give a specific example.

jobs.title: Executive Assistant, Corporate Performance Improvement
jobs.description:
**Description**


**About Alvarez \& Marsal**


Alvarez \& Marsal (A\&M) is a global consulting firm with over 10,000 entrepreneurial, action and results\-oriented professionals in over 40 countries. We take a hands\-on approach to solving our clients' problems and assisting them in reaching their potential. Our culture celebrates independent thinkers and doers who positively impact our clients and shape our industry. The collaborative environment and engaging work—guided by A\&M's core values of Integrity, Quality, Objectivity, Fun, Personal Reward, and Inclusive Diversity—are why our people love working at A\&M.

**The Team**


Alvarez \& Marsal is looking for a dynamic, enthusiastic Executive Assistant (EA) to join our Corporate Performance Improvement (CPI) team. This is a hybrid role: 4 days in\-office, 1 day remote, with standard hours of 8:30am to 5:30pm.


This role is ideal for someone early in their career who wants to learn how senior executives and a professional services firm actually operate day to day and at a strategic level. The right candidate is highly organized, curious about how a business runs, comfortable with responsibility, and eager to learn from senior leaders. You'll work directly alongside Managing Directors and build skills that set you up for whatever comes next.


We're looking for someone who's genuinely curious, comfortable taking on responsibility, and excited to learn by doing. Our EAs are made up of a team of professionals who support our top executives and teams across the globe. These critical team members are viewed as strategic partners who enable our teams to deliver gold\-standard work to our clients. The candidate should be motivated, resourceful, organized, poised, and able to operate independently with strong attention to detail.

**How you will contribute**

*Practice Support*

* Support CPI Managing Directors with daily priorities including time entry, expense reports, correspondence, scheduling, calendar management, and travel arrangements
* Coordinate internal and external meetings, from one\-on\-ones to full staff off\-sites, handling everything from room setup to catering to logistics
* Build relationships across the firm, working directly with employees and senior executives both inside and outside A\&M
* Support onboarding and offboarding processes for new hires and departing team members
* Get hands\-on with Excel, running analyses like event and contract comparisons
* Partner with corporate teams including IT, marketing, AR, AP, legal, and building operations to keep things running smoothly
* Take on additional projects as they come up

*Local Office Support*

* Be a go\-to resource for day\-to\-day office needs: conference rooms, meal ordering, supplies, mail, and maintenance requests, working alongside the local EA team
* Help keep CPI's common areas and conference rooms polished and client\-ready
* Jump in on additional duties as needed

**Qualifications**

* Bachelor's degree, with 1\-5 years of work experience
* A genuine interest in learning how a business and its leaders operate
* Strong interpersonal skills and the ability to juggle multiple executives and working styles
* Clear, confident written and verbal communication, comfortable engaging with senior leaders and external partners
* Solid working knowledge of Microsoft Office; familiarity with a range of AI tools is a plus
* A sharp eye for detail and follow\-through, you take pride in producing error\-free work
* A problem\-solver's mindset and the initiative to figure things out
* A team\-first attitude and professional presence

**Your journey at A\&M**


We recognize that our people are the driving force behind our success, which is why we prioritize an employee experience that fosters each person’s unique professional and personal development. Our robust performance development process promotes continuous learning, rewards your contributions, and fosters a culture of meritocracy. With top\-notch training and on\-the\-job learning opportunities, you can acquire new skills and advance your career.


We prioritize your well\-being, providing benefits and resources to support you on your personal journey. Our people consistently highlight the growth opportunities, our unique, entrepreneurial culture, and the fun we have together as their favorite aspects of working at A\&M. The possibilities are endless for high\-performing and passionate professionals.


Regular employees working 30 or more hours per week are also entitled to participate in Alvarez \& Marsal Holdings’ fringe benefits consisting of healthcare plans, flexible spending and savings accounts, life, AD\&D, and disability coverages at rates determined periodically as well as a 401(k) retirement savings plan. Provided the eligibility requirements are met, employees will also receive an annual discretionary contribution to their 401(k) retirement savings plan from Alvarez \& Marsal. Additionally, employees are eligible for paid time off including vacation, personal days, seventy\-two (72\) hours of sick time (prorated for part time employees), ten federal holidays, one floating holiday, and parental leave. The amount of vacation and personal days available varies based on tenure and role type. Click here for more information regarding A\&M’s benefits programs.


The salary range is $60,000 \- $75,000 annually, dependent on several variables including but not limited to education, experience, skills, and geography. In addition, A\&M offers a discretionary bonus program which is based on a number of factors, including individual and firm performance. Please ask your recruiter for details.

jobs.description:
Discover Your Career at Emory University: Emory University is a leading research university that fosters excellence and attracts world\-class talent to innovate today and prepare leaders for the future. We welcome candidates who can contribute to the excellence of our academic community. Description:

The Eagle\-Eye Suite is seeking a highly motivated and detail\-oriented Clinical Research Coordinator (CRC) II to support groundbreaking ophthalmic research with a focus on glaucoma, axonal imaging, and ocular biomechanics. This position is funded by both the National Institutes of Health (NIH) and the Emory Eye Center. The CRC II will play a central role in recruiting, screening, and enrolling participants into clinical research studies; performing high\-quality optical coherence tomography (OCT) imaging of the optic nerve head and retina; preparing and maintaining Institutional Review Board (IRB) submissions; extracting retrospective data from EPIC; and manually segmenting OCT images to support AI research. The role requires frequent interaction with patients, research staff, and clinicians from Emory and VA clinics.  

ABOUT THE EAGLE\-EYE SUITE. Founded in July 2025 by Dr. Michaël Girard, the Eagle\-Eye Suite is the first AI\-powered imaging suite for eye health in the Georgia region. Located in Clinic B of the Emory Eye Center, the facility is dedicated to advancing diagnosis, prognosis, and treatment strategies for both eye and systemic diseases, with a strong emphasis on glaucoma research and biomechanics of the optic nerve head and axons.  

The Clinical Research Coordinator II handles administrative activities generally associated with the conduct of clinical trials.  

KEY RESPONSIBILITIES:* Manages research project databases, develops flow sheets and other study related documents, and completes source documents/case report forms.
* Provides guidance to less experienced staff.
* Interfaces with research participants, determines eligibility and consents study participants according to protocol.
* Approves orders for supplies and equipment maintenance.
* Assists in developing recruitment strategies and conducting screenings for study participants including interviews and questionnaires.
* Supervises collection of study specimens and processing.
* Establishes case packages for study procedures, monitors scheduling of procedures and charges, coordinates other services as needed.
* Ensures compliance with research protocols, reviews case report forms and audits for accuracy with source documents, attends monitoring meetings with sponsors.
* Prepares regulatory submissions.
* With appropriate credentialing and training may perform phlebotomy or diagnostics.
* Performs related approved responsibilities as required.


MINIMUM QUALIFICATIONS:* High School Diploma or GED and five years of clinical research experience.
* Or two years of college in a scientific, health related, or business administration program and three years clinical research experience.
* Or a licensed as a practical nurse (LPN) and two years clinical research experience.
* Or a Bachelor's degree in a scientific, health related, or business administration related program and one year of clinical research experience.
* Or a Master's degree, MD or PhD in a scientific, health related or business administration program.


This position is intended to support clinical research and all clinical training requirements must be tracked and monitored through Emory Healthcare under the credentialing category of Clinical Researcher.

jobs.description:
Overview:

The Trade Show and Experiential Marketing Manager owns the end\-to\-end strategy and execution of trade shows, experiential marketing, and client/prospect engagement events to drive lead generation, brand awareness, and revenue growth. This person manages event budgets, holds vendors accountable across planning, execution, and reconciliation, and partners closely with Sales, Marketing, and Product to build compelling event experiences that generate qualified leads and strengthen client relationships. This role prioritizes high\-impact Tier 1 shows and owns the Tier 2 show portfolio; Tier 3 shows are self\-service and sales\-led, with this role providing light\-touch registration and platform support.


Responsibilities:
* Leads full\-cycle strategy and execution for Tier 1 (high\-impact) trade shows and owns the Tier 2 show portfolio, applying selection criteria tied to performance data, ICP fit, and revenue impact to prioritize investment across the show calendar.
* Elevates the onsite experience and product demo capability at Tier 2 shows, ensuring meaningful demo support at that tier.
* Develops comprehensive event budgets ranging from $10k to $200k\+ across Tier 1 and Tier 2 shows (10x10 to 20x40 booth sizes), including cost projections, vendor negotiations, drayage, electrical, and labor costs.
* Tracks actuals against budget projections and produces detailed post\-event ROI analysis; creates cost\-mitigation recommendations when overages occur.
* Partners with major trade show vendors and venues to plan, execute, and resolve challenges across pre\-event planning, on\-site installation, and post\-event reconciliation.
* Holds vendors accountable to contracts, SLAs, and service delivery standards; manages convention center and hotel logistics, booth construction, AV, catering, and ancillary services.
* Works closely with Sales Leadership and Account Managers to ensure trade shows serve as a strategic lever for deal acceleration, client engagement, and pipeline expansion.
* Translates complex event logistics and data into actionable insights Sales can use onsite and post\-show.
* Collaborates with Product Marketing and Design to create cohesive, on\-brand event experiences.
* Coordinates with Marketing on pre\-event campaigns, content, and lead capture enablement.
* Schedules planning meetings, develops agendas, and ensures all stakeholders align on event goals and GTM strategy.
* Provides support for self\-service, sales\-led Tier 3 shows, including event registration setup and iCapture configuration.
* Manages and executes experiential marketing and client/prospect engagement events, including offsite happy hours during trade shows, client/prospect transportation, invitations, and gifting for groups of 10\-50 people.
* Plans and executes client and prospect sporting events (up to 10 attendees) and prospect\-focused mini summits hosted at client offices, including presentations, lunch, invitations, and gifting.
* Develops event strategy aligned with sales and business objectives, identifying new opportunities that fit target markets and corporate goals.
* Plans and executes booth design, layout, branding, and attendee experience.
* Coordinates registration, staffing, promotional materials, and speaking engagements.
* Leverages the org's events platforms (e.g., Swoogo, iCapture) for lead capture, registration, and seamless follow\-up enablement with sales.
* Produces post\-event reports with actionable recommendations to continuously improve ROI.

  


Qualifications:
* Bachelor’s degree in marketing, event management, or similar.
* 7\+ years of experience in trade show/event management, field marketing, or experiential marketing, with exposure to convention center and hotel venues.
* Proven expertise in event budgeting and cost management; proficiency with Excel for forecasting, projections, and variance analysis.
* Demonstrated ability to manage vendors and hold them accountable across planning, execution, and reconciliation phases.
* Strong relationships and collaboration skills with Sales leadership, Account Managers, and cross\-functional Marketing teams.
* Excellent presentation and communication skills; ability to distill complex logistics into clear, actionable recommendations.
* Ability to travel to a portfolio of Tier 1 trade shows throughout the year (typically 3\-5 days per show)
* Proficiency with lead\-tracking tools (e.g., Popl), project management platforms (e.g., Asana), and registration platforms (e.g., Swoogo) preferred.
* Experience with design and brand management in event settings preferred.


Benefits:
* Medical and Dental coverage available for employees, dependents, domestic partners, and spouses
* Paid Time Off – Flexible options plus 10 paid company holidays where available\*\*
* All full\-time positions are hybrid, with many eligible to be completely remote
* Fully Paid by Origami Risk – Vision insurance, Short \& Long\-Term Disability Insurance, and Basic Life Insurance
* Generous family leave options—including adoption and foster care placements
* Pre\-Tax Savings Accounts – Flexible Spending Account, Health Savings Account, Commuter Benefits, Dependent Care Savings Account
* Retirement Savings – 401(k) with company match up to 4%
* Employee Assistance Program (EAP) – Confidential \& Free support offered to colleagues facing personal or work\-related complications
* Education Assistance Program – to help colleagues pursue industry/role\-specific certifications
* Wellness Benefits – reimbursement program to invest in healthy habits as well as support better colleague productivity and stress management

*\*\*Flexible PTO not available in California or the UK*

Purchasing Power is a leading employee purchase program that helps people buy the products and services they need through the convenience of payroll deduction. As part of PROG Holdings (NYSE: PRG), a FinTech holding company with more than 20 years of experience, we’re focused on building simple, responsible financial solutions that put people first. PROG Holdings’ portfolio includes Progressive Leasing, a market leader in lease‑to‑own solutions, Purchasing Power, and Four, a Buy Now Pay Later (BNPL) platform — all united by a commitment to innovation, access, and meaningful impact.


Job Description
Job Description


\*\*\* **This role is a PPC role\*\*\***

Purchasing Power is a leading employee purchase program that helps people buy the products and services they need through the convenience of payroll deduction. As part of PROG Holdings (NYSE: PRG), a FinTech holding company with more than 20 years of experience, we’re focused on building simple, responsible financial solutions that put people first. PROG Holdings’ portfolio includes Progressive Leasing, a market leader in lease‑to‑own solutions, Purchasing Power, and Four, a Buy Now Pay Later (BNPL) platform — all united by a commitment to innovation, access, and meaningful impact.


Learn more at purchasingpower.com


We are hiring a **Strategic Account Manager** that will serve as the trusted advisor and primary liaison to clients and brokers with the objectives of initiating and cultivating successful partnerships between Purchasing Power and key client accounts and brokers. The SAE will be responsible for the overall management of internal activities of a growing book of accounts within designated broker and client territories. This role will be accountable for the growth and increased profitability of existing business, assisting the acquisition of new business, and the strategic direction of assigned accounts and broker partnerships.


*This is a hybrid role that requires in‑office presence in Atlanta, Georgia.*

**What You Will Do:**

* Meet target revenue and revenue per eligible rates for each assigned account
* Represent Purchasing Power at the executive level of our clients and brokers to build strong relationships and be able to educate each audience (broker, client, and consumer) of our value proposition
* Proactively offer guidance to help educate our broker and client partners for needed training programs
* Expand and cultivate each account and assigned broker region through frequent visits, ongoing communication, and accurate reporting
* Develop marketing opportunities for promotion to maximize program effectiveness for each account, utilizing broker portals and other communication tools available
* Ensure that account contract terms are adhered to and that all account needs are addressed
* Provide insight and information to cross\-functional internal departments to assist SAE to become a valuable resource and partner
* Understand of account industry trends as well as voluntary benefit trends to identity new business opportunities with client and broker partners
* Proactively identify and report potential risks associated with each client and broker
* Effectively identify and partner with brokers to execute any upsell opportunities
* Optimize client and broker experience across sales, client services, marketing, and customer experience
* Serve as account owner and decision maker on relationship affecting issues/escalations
* Develop strategic recommendation for continual improvement and expansion of client and broker relationships
* Document new processes/policies/procedures relating to the client and oversees training on these to applicable internal staff

**The Experience You Will Bring:**

* Bachelor's degree in Business or related field or equivalent relevant experience.
* 5\+ years of Account management experience
* Experience with managing employee benefit offerings / programs
* Possess financial acumen, analytical and operations skills
* Experience using Microsoft Office products (Pivot tables, Power Point, etc)
* Experience using CRM tools (Salesforce)
* Able to travel as needed for client stewardships, benefit fairs, client/broker, and events
* Proven annual goal attainment
* Superior written and oral communication skills and excellent presentation skills
* Strong time management and organizational skills; ability to maintain a high quality of work in a deadline driven environment
* AI\-enabled tools are already part of how work gets done across our organization, and their use will continue to expand over time. We value people who are curious, adaptable, and open to learning as roles and workflows evolve.
* Ability to build relationships \& network both internally and externally
* Ability to work in\-office 3 days a week
* Ability to travel 35% of the time
*Purchasing Power welcomes and encourages diversity in the workplace. We do not discriminate in any aspect of employment on the basis of race, color, religion, national origin, ancestry, gender, sexual orientation, gender identity and/or expression, age, veteran status, disability, or any other characteristic protected by federal, state, or local employment discrimination laws where Purchasing Power does business.*

jobs.title: Sales Account Manager
jobs.description:
**Company Description** Big Green Machinery Inc. is a growing industrial equipment and automation company serving customers across the United States. As an authorized U.S. distributor of HELI Forklift and PUDU Robotics, the company provides material handling equipment, industrial robotics, and automation solutions to a wide range of industries. Its product portfolio includes forklifts, service robots, and other automation technologies that help businesses improve productivity, efficiency, and operational performance. Big Green Machinery focuses on understanding each customer’s operational needs and delivering practical, long\-term solutions. The company is committed to building strong relationships with customers, dealers, and partners while offering reliable equipment, innovative technology, and responsive support.

**Role Description** The Sales Account Manager is a full\-time, on\-site role based in Atlanta, GA. This position is responsible for managing and growing a portfolio of customer accounts, including developing relationships with new and existing clients across industrial and commercial sectors. Day\-to\-day tasks include identifying sales opportunities, conducting product presentations and demonstrations, preparing quotes and proposals, and negotiating terms to close deals. The Sales Account Manager will track sales activity, maintain accurate CRM records, and collaborate with internal teams to ensure timely delivery, after\-sales support, and high customer satisfaction. The role also involves participating in lead generation activities, attending industry events when needed, and providing ongoing account support to drive repeat business and long\-term partnerships.

**Qualifications**

* Customer\-focused capabilities, including Customer Satisfaction and Customer Service skills, to build trust and maintain strong relationships.
* Account Management experience, with the ability to oversee multiple customer accounts, track performance, and identify growth opportunities.
* Lead Generation skills, including prospecting, qualifying opportunities, and developing targeted outreach strategies.
* Strong Communication skills, both written and verbal, to deliver clear product information, proposals, and negotiations.
* Previous experience in B2B sales, preferably in industrial equipment, material handling, automation, or related sectors.
* Proficiency with CRM systems and basic office software (e.g., spreadsheets, presentations, email tools).
* Ability to work on\-site in Atlanta, GA, visit customer locations as needed, and collaborate effectively with cross\-functional teams.
* Strong organizational skills, attention to detail, and a results\-oriented approach to meeting sales targets.

Please submit resume to **sales@bgmamerica.com** or contact us directly through LinkedIn.

Pay: $60,000\.00 \- $100,000\.00 per year

Benefits:

* 401(k)
* Cell phone reimbursement
* Health insurance
* Mileage reimbursement
* Vision insurance

Work Location: In person

jobs.title: Landscape Account Manager
jobs.description:
**Work With The Best**
----------------------


We are building the premier outdoor living company in the country by creating a “family of family companies” across the nation. Now you can build your landscaping career with the best, working in one of our many company locations nationwide. Learn from the top experts in the field and work on some of the country’s largest and most complex landscape projects. Take advantage of opportunities to share and exchange best practices across our network. The opportunities are endless.

**About Us:** At Ed Castro Landscape, we are redefining luxury outdoor living through innovative design, precision installation, and exceptional maintenance services. Serving the Greater Atlanta area, we specialize in creating sophisticated, sustainable landscapes for high\-end residential and commercial clients. Our team is driven by craftsmanship, attention to detail, and an unwavering commitment to client satisfaction.

**Position Summary:** Ed Castro Landscape is hiring a Landscape Account Manager to join the team. The Account Manager (Client Representative) plays a critical role in delivering an elevated client experience while driving operational excellence and profitability. This is a highly visible, client\-facing position that blends relationship management, field operations, horticultural expertise, and leadership.


The ideal candidate thrives in a fast\-paced, high\-expectation environment and is passionate about delivering best\-in\-class landscape solutions.

**KEY RESPONSIBILITIES:**

**Client \& Account Management**

* Serve as the primary point of contact for assigned landscape maintenance clients
* Conduct regular property inspections to ensure quality, identify needs, and maintain contract compliance
* Develop and present proposals, enhancements, and detailed cost estimates
* Coordinate services from proposal through execution with accuracy and timeliness
* Maintain proactive, professional communication to exceed client expectations
* Support billing, collections, and documentation for maintenance and enhancement services

**Team Leadership \& Operations**

* Oversee landscape maintenance crews through effective leadership of a Production Manager
* Train, coach, and develop team members on safety, quality standards, and best practices
* Perform routine quality control visits to ensure work meets company and client standards
* Manage schedules and workflows to maintain efficiency and service excellence
* Ensure accurate documentation for contracts, enhancements, and site updates
* Troubleshoot field challenges and implement timely, effective solutions

**Horticulture \& Technical Expertise**

* Apply strong knowledge of Georgia plant material, turf management, and seasonal care practices
* Read and interpret landscape plans, blueprints, and site specifications
* Oversee proper use of fertilizers, pest control, and disease management programs
* Diagnose and manage irrigation systems
* Support installation and maintenance of low\-voltage landscape lighting

**Sales \& Profitability**

* Achieve or exceed revenue and profitability targets for assigned accounts
* Identify and develop opportunities for enhancements and additional services
* Monitor budgets and contribute to job costing and P\&L performance
* Maintain accurate estimating, tracking, and billing records

**QUALIFICATIONS:**

* Minimum 5 years of experience in landscape account management or operations
* Strong horticultural knowledge, preferably within Georgia or similar climates
* Valid, clean driver’s license
* Industry certifications (e.g., Georgia Certified Landscape Professional) preferred
* Experience with industry software (Aspire, CompanyCam, GeoTab) and Microsoft Office
* Bilingual (English/Spanish) is a plus
* Strong communication, leadership, and organizational skills
* Ability to read and interpret site plans and maintenance specifications

**THE PERKS:**

* 401(k) with company match
* Medical, dental, and vision insurance
* FSA / HSA options
* Life and long\-term disability insurance
* Paid time off
* Tuition reimbursement (after one year of service)
* Employee perks and discount programs

Please note this job description is not designed to cover or contain a comprehensive listing of activities, duties or responsibilities that are required of the employee for this job. Duties, responsibilities, and activities may change at any time with or without notice.

jobs.description:
Most companies claim to have the best people. We say to them, "Keep dreaming." Our people are second to none. They set us apart with their entrepreneurial spirit and ambition. They come to us from the likes of Amazon, Microsoft, Nordstrom, Starbucks and the sports world, bringing energy, bold ideas and a willingness to dive into the unfamiliar. It's our people that make BDA the top global Merchandise Agency to work for.

**JOB SUMMARY**



The Account Manager leads assigned lines of business, including areas of Kids \& Family, coordinating with the client and internal teams/coworkers, to achieve budgeted revenue, margin and NPS goals and ensure exceptional client trust, confidence and satisfaction.


**LOCATION:**

* This role follows a hybrid schedule, with **4 days onsite and 1 day remote each week**.
* To be considered, candidates must reside within commuting distance of our **Dallas, TX** or **Atlanta, GA** officeas regular in\-person collaboration is an essential part of the role.


**Experience Requirements**


* 3\+ years proven experience in business, marketing or related field
* Experience working with kid consumer products and/or kid\-related business a bonus
* Proven experience in client relationship management and presentation development/delivery
* Project management experience, managing internal stakeholders and clients
* Intermediate computer skills with MS Office software: Word, Excel, PowerPoint and Outlook


**Job Skills \& Traits**


* Strong strategic mindset with the ability to think creatively and develop engaging product ideas
* Exceptional organizational and project management skills, with the ability to track timelines, prioritize tasks, proactively solve challenges and ensure smooth execution
* Ability to prioritize and manage multiple tasks/assignments, sometimes under tight timeframes
* Detail oriented
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills, including email interaction
* Comfortable presenting to and engaging clients
* Team collaborator, with the ability to lead and participate in a collaborative environment
* Self\-directed, working autonomously while keeping supervisor apprised of progress
* Strong financial acumen with an understanding of calculating financial data such as margins and sales projections to ensure profitable sales results


**Duties \& Responsibilities**


* Cultivates and maintains strong relationships with clients to build trust and confidence, proactively addressing challenges and using information to develop and maximize business opportunities
* Uses kids \& family expertise to help coordinate creation of engaging, age\-appropriate products that drive brand affinity among the clients' target audience
* Collaborates with internal teams to ensure smooth, on\-time delivery of products and services
* Manages specific lines of business internally and externally with efficiency and accuracy to ensure client expectations are exceeded
* Understands, interprets and analyzes financial aspects of accounts to provide recommendations on ways to improve lines of business
* Stays informed about the competitive landscape and industry trends to enhance our offerings and maintain a competitive edge
* Maintains high levels of professionalism when interacting with internal teams, coworkers and clients
* Achieves annual sales revenue, margin and NPS goals on assigned account(s)


*We are pleased to share the base salary range for this position is $70,000 to $82,000\. The range listed is just one component of BDA's total compensation and rewards programs, which includes: robust PTO; vacation, a paid volunteer day, holidays and summer Fridays, Benefits; medical, dental, vision, life, and AD\&D insurance, 401k; tuition reimbursement, mental health and financial wellness programs and professional development opportunities including tuition reimbursement. jobs.title: Marketing Specialist
jobs.description:
**Company Description**  

We’re an ambitious, forward\-thinking global business who build transformative solutions for our customers to deliver best\-in\-class sustainable mobility, connectivity and technology solutions. We support our customers with a range of products and services to meet their needs.


Since 1990 our ambition has never wavered. From humble beginnings, our vision and drive has seen us venture into new markets with confidence and stay ahead of market trends. Our mission is to help businesses of all sizes adapt to the future and take advantage of the opportunities that change brings. Sustainability is at the core of our offering. With our leading e\-mobility solutions, we’re committed to guiding businesses through the energy transition, building solutions for a more sustainable, connected future.


This is where you come in. We are on a journey of growth. We pride ourselves on being at the forefront of technology innovation and we invite you along on this journey.

 **Job Description** **Location:** Atlanta, Georgia (Office\-Based, 5 Days Per Week)  

**Salary:** $70,000 \- $90,000 per annum


We're looking for a highly motivated **Marketing Specialist** to help accelerate growth across our US Telematics business.


This is an exciting opportunity for an early to mid\-career marketer who enjoys rolling up their sleeves and making things happen. You'll play a pivotal role in driving lead generation, supporting partner growth, executing local marketing campaigns, and working closely with sales teams to generate demand across both direct and indirect channels.


You'll be responsible for turning ideas into action, collaborating with central marketing teams while taking ownership of local execution. This role would suit someone who is naturally curious, data\-driven, creative, and eager to develop deep expertise in a fast\-growing technology sector.

**What You'll Be Doing**


Demand Generation \& Performance Marketing

* Execute digital marketing campaigns focused on generating high\-quality B2B leads.
* Manage and optimise PPC campaigns, including Google Ads.
* Support SEO initiatives and website conversion optimisation activities.
* Monitor, analyse, and report on campaign performance, CPL, lead quality, and ROI.
* Use analytics and insights to continually refine and improve marketing effectiveness.


Customer \& Content Marketing

* Develop customer success stories, case studies, and testimonials.
* Work directly with customers to create engaging marketing content that supports new business growth.
* Support social media activity and content distribution across relevant channels.
* Create and localise marketing campaigns tailored to the US market.
* Develop sales enablement content and marketing collateral.


Partner \& Channel Marketing

* Support the growth of indirect sales channels through partner\-focused marketing initiatives.
* Work closely with sales leaders to identify opportunities for partner acquisition and engagement.
* Assist with the launch and promotion of new products and services through partner networks.
* Execute targeted outbound campaigns to support indirect growth objectives.


Website \& Brand Management

* Support the management and enhancement of the US Radius website.
* Create and maintain product, campaign, and landing page content.
* Ensure local marketing activity aligns with global brand standards.
* Utilise design tools such as Canva to produce high\-quality marketing assets.


Collaboration \& Commercial Impact

* Partner closely with Sales, Product, and Central Marketing teams.
* Gain a deep understanding of the telematics market, customer journey, and sales process.
* Provide market and competitor insights to support commercial decision\-making.
* Contribute directly to ambitious growth targets across both direct and indirect channels.

  

**Qualifications**  

Essential

* 2\-5 years' marketing experience, ideally within B2B technology, SaaS, telecommunications, mobility, or related sectors.
* Hands\-on experience executing digital marketing campaigns.
* Strong understanding of lead generation, demand generation, PPC, social media, and marketing analytics.
* Experience using data to measure performance and make informed decisions.
* Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills.
* Ability to work independently and take ownership of projects from concept through execution.
* Strong organisational and project management skills.
* Creative mindset with the ability to generate and execute new ideas.


Desirable

* Experience working with CRM and marketing automation platforms such as Salesforce.
* Experience creating customer stories, case studies, and sales enablement content.
* Familiarity with Canva or other design tools.
* Experience within Telematics, Fleet Management, Mobility, IoT, or Connected Vehicle industries.
* Basic knowledge of SEO and website content management.

  

**Additional Information** **Why Join Us?**


This role offers a unique opportunity to make a visible impact in a growing business. You'll have the autonomy to shape local marketing activity while benefiting from the support and expertise of an established global marketing function.


If you're looking for a role where you can build campaigns, analyse performance, collaborate with sales teams, create compelling content, and directly influence business growth, we'd love to hear from you.

**Benefits**

* Competitive salary
* Retail discounts
* Health and wellbeing support services
* Friendly and collaborative culture
* Fast\-growing, innovative organisation
* Opportunities for development and progression
* Inclusive workplace that values innovation, agility, and drive

jobs.title: Business Development Representative - YM Careers Network
jobs.description:
**Job Description**
===================

**Business Development Representative (BDR) – YM Careers Network**

YM Careers is seeking a motivated, ambitious, and relationship\-driven Business Development Representative (BDR) to join our growing sales team. This role is ideal for early\-career professionals who are eager to learn consultative sales, develop business development expertise, and help organizations connect with highly qualified talent through industry\-specific career centers.


As a BDR, you will be responsible for identifying and engaging recruiters, talent acquisition leaders, and hiring managers at organizations that have not yet utilized the YM Careers Network. You'll introduce prospective employers to our portfolio of niche career centers, uncover hiring challenges, and create opportunities for our Account Executive team to demonstrate how YM Careers can help organizations reach specialized professional audiences.


This role is an excellent fit for someone who enjoys building relationships, is energized by prospecting and outreach, and wants a clear path for career growth in sales and recruitment marketing. YM Careers provides comprehensive training, structured onboarding, ongoing coaching, and mentorship from experienced sales leaders.


**A Day in the Life**

* Research and identify prospective employers, recruiters, and talent acquisition professionals within target organizations.
* Prospect new business opportunities through cold calling, email outreach, LinkedIn networking, and other outbound sales activities.
* Engage hiring decision\-makers in consultative conversations to understand their recruitment challenges, hiring goals, and talent acquisition strategies.
* Educate prospective clients on the value of niche career centers and how YM Careers helps employers connect with highly qualified industry\-specific talent.
* Qualify opportunities and schedule introductory meetings and product demonstrations for the sales team.
* Utilize tools such as Salesforce, LinkedIn Sales Navigator, ZoomInfo, and other prospecting platforms to build and manage pipeline activity.
* Collaborate with sales leadership and teammates to refine messaging, outreach strategies, and prospecting best practices.
* Maintain accurate records of prospect interactions, activities, and opportunities within Salesforce.
* Develop expertise in recruitment advertising, talent acquisition trends, and the unique hiring needs of professional associations and their employer communities.
* Collaborate with Marketing to plan and deliver monthly webinars for recruiters, generating engagement, nurturing prospects, and creating new business opportunities for the sales team.
* Attend recruiting and talent acquisition industry conferences and trade shows to network with prospective clients, increase brand awareness, and identify new sales opportunities.

**What Success Looks Like**

* Consistently generating qualified sales opportunities for the Account Executive team.
* Building a strong pipeline of prospective employers across multiple industries.
* Developing confidence in outbound prospecting, discovery conversations, and value\-based selling.
* Becoming a trusted resource for organizations seeking effective ways to attract specialized talent.
Contributing to the continued growth and success of the YM Careers Network.  
* 

**What You Bring**

**Qualifications**

* **Bachelor’s degree in Business, Marketing, Communications, or related field preferred OR 1–3 years of relevant work experience** (internships, part‑time jobs, campus leadership, customer service, volunteer roles, etc.)
* Strong proficiency in **Microsoft Office** (Excel, Word, PowerPoint, Outlook)
* Clear, professional communication skills — written and verbal
* Interest in learning sales and building a long‑term career in a customer‑facing role

**Characteristics**

* Curious and eager to learn new skills
* Proactive self‑starter with a positive, can‑do attitude
* Resilient when facing challenges or rejection
* Strong critical thinking and problem‑solving abilities
* High attention to detail and good organizational habits
* Comfortable talking to new people and building relationships

Team player who enjoys contributing to a supportive, collaborative environment  

* 

**Work Environment \& Flexibility**

This role follows a **hybrid work schedule** based at our Buckhead office in Atlanta (3495 Piedmont Road NE Atlanta, GA 30305\):


* **Onsite:** Tuesday–Thursday
* **Remote:** Monday, Friday

This structure supports team collaboration, coaching, and hands‑on learning — all essential for early‑career success.

Momentive Software amplifies the impact of over 20,000 purpose\-driven organizations in over 30 countries, with over $11 billion raised and 55 million members served to date. Momentive partners with organizations that believe "good enough" is never enough – so they can bring on better outcomes for everyone they serve. Learn more at momentivesoftware.com .

jobs.title: Customer Success Operations - Platform and Reporting
jobs.description:
**Our Purpose**

*Mastercard powers economies and empowers people in 200\+ countries and territories worldwide. Together with our customers, we’re helping build a sustainable economy where everyone can prosper. We support a wide range of digital payments choices, making transactions secure, simple, smart and accessible. Our technology and innovation, partnerships and networks combine to deliver a unique set of products and services that help people, businesses and governments realize their greatest potential.*

**Title and Summary**


Customer Success Operations \- Platform and Reporting
Title and Summary  

  

The Customer Success Operations – Platform \& Reporting role owns and advances the Loyalty Gainsight deployment and the reporting infrastructure that enables Customer Success teams to operate with consistent data, workflows, and executive\-ready insights. This role translates business requirements into scalable platform capabilities, dashboards, KPIs, and operating routines that help teams understand customer health, risk, adoption, outcomes, and value realization.  

  

Overview  

  

Services within Mastercard is responsible for acquiring, engaging, and retaining customers by managing fraud and risk, enhancing cybersecurity, and improving the digital payments experience. We provide value\-added services and leverage expertise, data\-driven insights, and execution.  

  

Our Customer Success teams play a crucial role in ensuring customers achieve their desired outcomes while maximizing the value of Mastercard’s products and services. The team supports onboarding, ongoing strategic engagement, customer feedback, product improvement, customer satisfaction, retention, advocacy, and value expansion.  

  

Role  

  

Are you passionate about building scalable platforms, reporting, and operational infrastructure that help customer\-facing teams deliver consistent, high\-impact customer experiences? Join Mastercard’s Services Customer Success team as a Customer Success Operations Senior Specialist focused on Platform \& Reporting.  

  

Platform Ownership \& Gainsight Deployment  

  

* Own the Loyalty Gainsight deployment roadmap, including configuration, enhancement prioritization, adoption, and ongoing optimization.
* Partner with Customer Success, Product, Program, and Regional teams to translate operating needs into scalable Gainsight workflows, playbooks, health scores, customer segmentation, and engagement models.
* Ensure Gainsight supports scaled, offline and digital Customer Success motions through integrated workflows and streamlined user experiences.
* Serve as a platform subject\-matter expert for Customer Success users, helping teams adopt consistent processes and maximize the value of the CS technology stack.

Social Media Manager
ACCOUNTABILITY STATEMENT  

  

As the Social Media Manager, you will lead VyStar Credit Union’s social media presence across all social platforms, driving brand awareness, product acquisition, follower growth, and positive member \& community engagement through engaging social\-first content. You will serve as a key social ambassador between internal departments, external partners, developing and executing a comprehensive social strategy that builds VyStar’s reputation as the credit union of the Southeast. jobs.title: Pro Sales Representative - Atlanta
jobs.description:
Position Purpose:  


The Pro Sales Representative works to build strong relationships with our Pro customers and executes a sales strategy to profitably grow sales for assigned accounts to support the organization's goals and increases the company's market share. This role is responsible for managing the full sales cycle of a designated portfolio, both existing and new, by identifying sales opportunities, managing a sales pipeline, and achieving assigned sales goals and gross margin targets. The Pro Sales Representative drives sales growth by proactively prospecting and engaging both new and existing B2B customers through high outbound activity, including cold calls, outreach initiatives. The Pro Sales Representative is also responsible for negotiating projects, developing tailored solutions to meet customer needs, closing sales, and resolving issues effectively and in a timely manner. The Pro Sales Representative must demonstrate broad product and services knowledge and utilize comprehensive business acumen and a knowledge of other functional departments to support the growth of their portfolio and effectively collaborate with cross\-functional partners.  


Key Responsibilities:  


10% \- Customer Review and Development \- Engage with sales leadership to review sales calls, provide account insights and sales plan opportunities with manager. Participate in training sessions focused on product knowledge (including, but not limited to, building supplies, construction jobs, etc.), process improvements, and strategic initiatives.  
30% \- Inbound Customer Engagement and Sales Growth \- Resolve order and delivery issues with a professional support team. Resolve customer challenges by investigating problems and developing sustainable and scalable solutions in collaboration with the in\-store Pro Sales teams and Pro Support team. Transact and tender, when necessary, with a professional support team. Follow\-up on completed orders for feedback.  
60% \- Outbound Customer Engagement and Sales Growth \- Research accounts, identify key players and generate interest. Achieve prospecting and sales goals effectively and consistently by proactively adjusting to market changes, closing sales and achieving sales plan. Source new sales opportunities through ongoing prospecting via inbound lead follow\-up and outbound warm/hot and cold calling. Drive incremental sales growth with assigned customer portfolio. Execute sales strategy by introducing both new and existing customers to our current capabilities, ensuring they understand how these solutions align with their specific needs. Strategically build and maintain strong customer relationships to foster long\-term partnerships by understanding and anticipating customer needs, offering custom solutions while effectively communicating competitive strengths. Effectively communicate competitive strengths and develop strategic goals to acquire incremental business.  


Direct Manager/Direct Reports:  


This Position typically reports to the Pro Sales Representative Manager  
This Position has 0 Direct Reports  


Travel Requirements:  


Typically requires overnight travel less than 5% of the time.  


Physical Requirements:  


Most of the time is spent sitting in a comfortable position and there is frequent opportunity to move about. On rare occasions, there may be a need to move or lift light articles.  


Working Conditions:  


Located in a comfortable indoor area. Any unpleasant conditions would be infrequent and not objectionable.  


Minimum Qualifications:  


Must be 18 years of age or older  
Must be legally permitted to work in the United States  


Preferred Qualifications:  


Working knowledge of Microsoft Office Suite  
Working knowledge of presentation software (e.g., Microsoft PowerPoint)  
Demonstrated ability to collaborate and work effectively with cross\-functional teams  
Demonstrated project management skills  
Ability to negotiate, handle complaints, settle disputes, and resolve grievances with both internal and external customers  
Excellent written and verbal communication skills  
Retail, proven inside sales or telephone sales experience  
Experience working with Salesforce.com or similar CRM  
Understanding and application of strategic planning to identify, target and execute plans for sales growth  
Highly motivated  
Understanding and application of strategic planning to identify, target and execute plans for sales growth in areas like building supplies, construction, and lumber  


Minimum Education:  


The knowledge, skills and abilities typically acquired through the completion of a high school diploma and/or GED.  


Preferred Education:  


The knowledge, skills and abilities typically acquired through the completion of a bachelor's degree program or equivalent degree in a field of study related to the job  


Minimum Years of Work Experience:  


2  


Preferred Years of Work Experience:  


3  


Minimum Leadership Experience:  


None  


Preferred Leadership Experience:  


None  


Certifications:  


None  


Competencies:  


Action Oriented  
Collaborates  
Communicates Effectively  
Customer Focus  
Drives Results

jobs.description:
**Benefits:**

**Outside Sales Representative**
================================


Build a Six\-Figure Recurring Income Stream in Your Market  

CAM Resources is expanding nationwide and looking for driven salespeople and entrepreneurs who want more than a traditional hourly or salary position.  

This is an opportunity to become a **Growth Partner** with an established commercial cleaning and facility\-services company and build a recurring book of business in your local market.  

You bring in the business.  

**We handle the fulfillment, cleaners, insurance, billing, proposals, operations, and back\-office support.**  

You focus on one thing:  

**Growing your market.**  

Why This Opportunity Is Different  

Most sales jobs pay you once and move on.  

With CAM Resources, you can earn **recurring compensation from qualifying accounts you help bring in and maintain**.  

That means the accounts you build can continue producing income month after month.  

The more business you build, the larger your recurring income can become.  

This is designed for someone who wants the upside of building a business without having to create the entire company from scratch.

Apartment communities

Offices

Carry cleaning equipment

Create invoices  
* 
Handle insurance  
* 
Build an operations department  
* 
Start a company from scratch

We already have the platform.  

You help build the market.  

Income Potential  

This is a **performance\-based opportunity with recurring compensation**.  

There is no fixed ceiling on what you can earn.  

The Growth Partners who perform best will be the people who consistently prospect, build relationships, schedule walkthroughs, and develop a growing portfolio of commercial accounts.  

If you are looking for a predictable hourly job, this may not be the right fit.  

If you are looking for the opportunity to **build something substantial and get paid based on what you produce**, we want to talk to you.  

Who We Want  

We are looking for people who are:  

Competitive  

* 
Self\-motivated  
* 
Comfortable talking to business owners and managers

Willing to walk into businesses and introduce themselves  
* 
Persistent with follow\-up  
* 
Comfortable with performance\-based compensation

Sales experience is helpful, but we care more about **drive, confidence, persistence, and activity**.  

Great Fit for People With Experience In

Staffing

Insurance sales

Payroll sales

Facility services

Home services  
* 
Commercial cleaning

Entrepreneurship

Small\-business ownership

The Opportunity  

CAM Resources is building a national network of local Growth Partners.  

The goal is simple:  

**Give strong salespeople the platform, systems, fulfillment, and support to build recurring commercial business without having to build the entire infrastructure themselves.**  

If you believe you can open doors, build relationships, and grow a market, apply today.  

We are looking for people who want to build something — not just fill a position.

jobs.title: Part-Time Sales Representative — Metro Atlanta
jobs.description:
Part\-Time Sales Representative — Metro Atlanta

Tossie Advisory Group (TAG)

About the Role

Tossie Advisory Group is looking for a part\-time, locally\-based Sales Representative to grow subscriptions to the TAG Command Center — a suite of AI\-powered financial literacy and career tools built for hourly workers, veterans, and single\-income households across Metro Atlanta. TAG was founded and is owned by a retired military veteran and retired VA employee — after a career inside the federal system, he watched qualified people get screened out of opportunities they were fully prepared for, not for lack of experience, but because their paperwork never made it past the first filter. That's the reason TAG exists.

This is a relationship\-driven, community\-facing sales role, not a cold\-call boiler room job. You'll introduce local churches, community organizations, veteran groups, and individuals to TAG's tools and books — helping people take their first step toward financial literacy and stronger career prospects, while earning commission on every subscriber and product sale you bring in.

What You'll Do

Represent TAG at local community events, veteran resource fairs, church financial\-literacy nights, and small\-business meetups across Metro Atlanta

Introduce prospects to the TAG Starter and Command Center subscription tiers, the "Stock Investing For Poor People" book series, and a la carte products — most notably The Read Resume Service (a personally hand\-reworked resume, done by the founder or his team — not AI self\-service — with a built\-in veteran discount)

Build simple relationships and follow\-ups with local organizations (referral partnerships, group presentations, tabling)

Track leads and closed sales using a shared log (Google Sheet or CRM provided)

Report weekly to the founder on activity and results

Compensation

Base: $15/hour for 12–15 hours/week (flexible scheduling, some evenings/weekends for events)

Commission: Additional per\-sale commission on top of base —

$10 per new TAG Starter subscriber ($19\.99/mo)

$20 per new TAG Command Center or Command Center Plus subscriber ($39\.99–$59\.99/mo)

$50 per new TAG Business subscriber ($150/mo)

15% commission on a la carte sales — including The Read Resume Service ($147 standard / $124\.95 veteran / \+$105 rush) and book sales

Commission paid monthly; no cap on earnings

Who We're Looking For

Lives in or near Metro Atlanta and can travel locally to events

Comfortable talking to people one\-on\-one and in small groups — no prior "tech sales" background required

Genuine interest in financial literacy, career development, or community outreach

Self\-starter who can manage their own schedule and follow up on leads

Bonus: existing ties to veteran organizations, churches, or community groups in the Atlanta area

About TAG

Tossie Advisory Group (TAG) blends faith, financial literacy, and street\-level wisdom to make investing and career growth accessible to people who've been left out of traditional financial education — grounded in the 3F Framework: Faith, Finance, Foundations. TAG is founded and owned by a retired military veteran and retired VA employee, which shapes its work with veterans, transitioning service members, and federal job seekers directly.

Soli Deo Gloria.

To Apply: Send a brief note about yourself and any community/organization connections in the Atlanta area.

Pay: $67,986\.17 \- $81,875\.82 per year

Benefits:

* Flexible schedule

Work Location: In person

jobs.description:
**Location:** Remote **Job Type:** Full\-Time **Compensation:** Draw \+ Lucrative Commission \+ Performance Incentives

 **The Opportunity**


Are you a self\-motivated "hunter" who thrives on variety? Guide Book Publishing, an industry leader since 1991, is looking for a strategic Advertising Account Executive. Unlike traditional sales roles where you call the same list for years, our team moves to a **new assignment every 2\-3 weeks**, helping local businesses across 24 states reach "micro\-communities" through high\-quality direct\-mail advertising.

 **How it Works**

* **The Workflow:** You’ll switch assignments frequently, focusing on businesses within a 3\-5 mile radius of a specific congregation or community center.
* **The Method:** 70% of your time is spent on high\-energy outreach (phone, email, and video meetings); 20% on market research; and 10% on contract execution.
* **The Flexibility:** This is a remote role, but does require getting your materials back to the Post Office to return to the Home Office.

 **Key Responsibilities**

* **New Business Development:** Identify and close new advertising partnerships to meet production goals.
* **Consultative Sales:** Educate local business owners on the ROI of being featured in our community guides and directories.
* **Relationship Management:** Act as the primary liaison between your clients and our operations staff to ensure an excellent experience.
* **Account Growth:** Nurture and maintain large\-scale accounts within your metro area.
* **Administrative Precision:** Manage contracts and paperwork accurately and return assignment materials via USPS upon completion.

 **Compensation \& Benefits**


We offer a structure that rewards high performers and provides security through a comprehensive benefits package via ADP TotalSource.

* **Draw \& Commission:** Payroll is based on "Cash In" from sales, with a Draw program available to stabilize income as you build your funnel.
* **Performance Bonuses:** Additional incentive pay for hitting Assignment, Monthly, Quarterly, and Annual targets.
* **Benefits:**
	+ Health, Dental, and Vision Insurance
	+ 401(k) with Company Match
	+ Life Insurance
	+ Paid Time Off (PTO)

 **Qualifications**

* **Experience:** 1\-2 years of sales experience preferred (or equivalent education).
* **Mindset:** A self\-starter who can manage their own schedule without being micromanaged.
* **Skills:** Proficient in Excel, scanning, email, and PDF management. Strong ability to calculate discounts and commissions accurately.
* **Communication:** Persuasive verbal skills and clear, professional written communication.
* **Requirements:** Valid Driver’s License and Auto Insurance.

 **Why Guide Book Publishing?**


We serve the communication needs of over 800 micro\-communities. If you are looking for a role that balances the freedom of remote work with the fast\-paced nature of community\-based sales, we want to talk to you.

 **Physical Demands and Work Environment:**

* Requires Valid Driver’s License and Auto Insurance
* Frequently required to sit and utilize a keyboard and phone.

jobs.description:

We welcome talented individuals who believe in our mission, drive the organization forward, and recognize the positive impact they can bring to our communities.
  
  

Position Summary
  
The Program Coordinator, Maternal Child Health (MCH) Male Involvement is a grant\-funded role responsible for program coordination and administrative oversight of Westside Healthy Start male involvement activities. This position is responsible for coordinating the functions related to program implementation, data collection, and reporting. The position provides education, referrals, and support to expectant fathers and new parents in individual and group settings.
  
  

This position requires travel to the following ACCESS health center locations \- Austin, Humboldt Park, Madison, Sinai, Warren (storage), Westside.
  
  

Core Job Responsibilities
  
  

1\. Coordinates the development, design, implementation, and day\-to\-day operations of male involvement programming at Westside Healthy Start sites
  
2\. Engages assigned or referred father/male participants in Westside Healthy Start male involvement case management curriculum across all Westside Healthy Start sites, including, assessing participant needs, developing service plans, and connecting participants to appropriate community resources
  
3\. Collects and manages program data and supports the development and maintenance of reporting tools for submission to internal and external venues
  
4\. Implements and facilitates male involvement group education sessions in accordance with grant requirements
  
5\. Provides follow\-up support, including call\-backs and ongoing engagement to promote sustained participation in male involvement activities
  
6\. Establishes and maintains external partnerships to support referrals and resource connections for program participants (e.g., employment opportunities, community services)
  
7\. Develops and coordinates engagement activities that promote father involvement, co\-parenting and child development activities
  
8\. Prepares and distributes monthly reports summarizing program activities, participation and outcomes in accordance with grant and leadership requirements
  
9\. Collaborates with Westside Healthy Start Community Health Specialists at each Westside Health Start site to ensure co\-parenting activities are successful.
  
10\. Other duties as assigned.
  
  

Requirements/Preferences
  
  

1\. Bachelor’s degree in a health\-related field (social work, psychology, counseling, rehabilitation, sociology, or other human service field) preferred
  
2\. Minimum 2 years of working in a community based or public health setting.
  
3\. Minimum 2 years of case management experience in a public or private social service program or health care setting.
  
4\. Intermediate proficiency with Microsoft Office products and database applications (i.e. Redcap, Electronic medical record).
  
5\. 2 years of project management experience in working with high\-risk populations preferred.
  
  

ACCESS is a Network of Federally Qualified Health Centers treating patients on the frontlines of community\-based health care. Depending on position applied/being recruited for, candidates may be required to be vaccinated against communicable diseases and provide supporting documentation proving that they are properly vaccinated, or apply for religious and/or medical vaccination exemption as a part of the application process.
  
  

The pay ranges provided represent the minimum to mid\-range for positions. Actual compensation will be determined based on a combination of factors including years of experience, educational background, market conditions, and available grant funding.

The Program Coordinator for the mentoring program enhances the reputation of AHF by working with the South Side Help Center team to demonstrate strong relationship\-building skills, emotional intelligence, and the ability to engage youth from diverse backgrounds with respect, patience, and consistency. **About Us**

CoreBuilt Contracting is a growing commercial general contractor based in Chicago, IL. We specialize in delivering fast\-paced, high\-quality commercial construction projects with a focus on field execution, coordination, and accountability.

**Position Overview** 

The Construction Project Manager leads the day\-to\-day execution of commercial construction projects, working closely with Superintendents, subcontractors, vendors, clients, and internal teams to keep work progressing safely, on schedule, and within budget.

This mid\-level role is responsible for coordinating project activities from preconstruction through closeout, including managing project documentation, tracking schedules and procurement, monitoring costs, resolving issues, and maintaining clear communication between the office and field. The Assistant Project Manager serves as a key point of contact for project stakeholders and helps ensure that subcontractors and vendors meet contractual, quality, and timeline expectations.

The ideal candidate has a strong understanding of commercial construction workflows, excellent organizational and communication skills, and the ability to manage multiple priorities in a fast\-paced environment. They take ownership of project details, anticipate potential challenges, and work proactively to keep all aspects of the project aligned.

**What You’ll Be Doing**

**Project Management \& Coordination**

* Lead day\-to\-day coordination of commercial construction projects in partnership with Project Managers, Superintendents, subcontractors, vendors, and clients.
* Monitor project milestones, deliverables, field progress, and critical\-path activities to help keep work on schedule and aligned with project objectives.
* Coordinate subcontractor activities, vendor communication, material deliveries, site access, and logistics requirements.
* Identify and help resolve scheduling conflicts, scope gaps, site constraints, and other issues that could affect project performance.
* Serve as a central communication link between office and field teams, ensuring timely distribution of project updates, decisions, and action items.

**Documentation \& Project Controls**

* Maintain complete, accurate project records, including contracts, drawings, specifications, submittals, RFIs, change orders, meeting minutes, correspondence, and closeout documents.

* Support project closeout by coordinating punch\-list tracking, warranties, as\-built documentation, final inspections, and turnover requirements.

* Maintain project schedules and short\-term look\-ahead plans with input from field leadership and trade partners.
* Lead or coordinate project meetings, site walks, progress meetings, inspections, and pre\-installation discussions; issue agendas, meeting minutes, and follow\-up items.
* Monitor procurement status, long\-lead materials, purchase orders, equipment needs, and delivery schedules to prevent disruptions to field operations.
* Confirm site readiness, storage requirements, access, and installation sequencing before scheduled material or equipment deliveries.
* Follow up with subcontractors and vendors to ensure timely responses, compliance with project requirements, and adherence to schedule commitments.

* Coordinate permitting applications, project startup documentation, insurance and compliance requirements, and preconstruction meeting logistics.
* Assist with development of project execution plans, procurement schedules, preliminary logistics plans, and subcontractor onboarding materials.

* Maintain organized project and company records while supporting standardized processes across active jobs.
* Coordinate invoice processing, vendor documentation, compliance records, and general administrative requirements related to project operations.
* Manage calendars, meetings, travel arrangements, reports, agendas, and action\-item tracking for project and executive leadership as needed.
* Support special projects, internal research, process improvements, and company initiatives that strengthen project delivery and operational efficiency.

**Qualifications**

* 3–5\+ years of experience in commercial construction, project management, project engineering, estimating, or a related field.
* Working knowledge of commercial construction processes, including preconstruction, procurement, scheduling, subcontractor coordination, project controls, and closeout.
* Demonstrated ability to manage multiple active projects, competing deadlines, and detailed deliverables in a fast\-paced environment.

* Proficiency in Microsoft Office, particularly Excel, Word, Outlook, and project reporting tools.

new_jobs.description:
Job Summary:


**WHO ARE YOU?**

Are you passionate about electronic dance music and live events? Do you thrive in a fast\-paced environment where creativity, collaboration, and strategic marketing come together? We're looking for a highly motivated, proactive marketer with a passion for music, culture, and creating impactful campaigns that connect fans with unforgettable experiences. Is this you? Read on…  



**WHO ARE WE?**

Insomniac produces some of the most innovative, immersive music festivals and events in the world. Enhanced by state\-of\-the\-art lighting, pyrotechnics and sound design, large\-scale art installations, theatrical performers and next generation special effects, our events captivate the senses and inspire a unique level of fan interaction. The quality of the Headliner experience is our top priority.  



Insomniac produces 10,000 concerts, club nights and festivals for seven million attendees annually across the globe. Since its inception, Insomniac's events have taken place in 13 countries across five continents. The company's premiere annual event, Electric Daisy Carnival Las Vegas, is the world’s largest dance music festival and attracts more than 525,000 fans over three days. The company was founded by Pasquale Rotella and has been based in Los Angeles since it was formed in 1993\.  



**THE ROLE**

Insomniac Events is seeking a Marketing Coordinator to join our Festival Marketing team. This role plays a key part in the planning, coordination, and execution of integrated marketing campaigns that support our portfolio of festivals and branded events. Working closely with cross\-functional teams, artists, and external partners, the Marketing Coordinator helps bring campaigns to life while ensuring projects remain organized, on schedule, and aligned with overall marketing objectives.


This position reports to the Director of Festivals and is based in our Calabasas, CA office, with regular travel to on\-site event locations as needed. This is not a remote position.

* Partner with the team to brainstorm content strategies and manage social media content calendars for assigned projects.

* Support the execution of on\-site marketing initiatives, including media, social, influencer, and street team activations for assigned events.
* Ensure clear, timely, and accurate communication across cross\-functional teams and external partners throughout the campaign lifecycle.
* Stay informed on emerging marketing trends, social platforms, and industry best practices, applying new ideas and sharing actionable insights to drive innovative, forward\-thinking campaigns.
* Use a personal vehicle to travel to business engagements as needed and travel out of town for business when required.
